methods.name: Primitive distinguishable-particle PIMD
methods.scope: Closed distinguishable-particle ring-polymer equilibrium sampling. Imaginary-time beads are a statistical representation; fictitious sampling time is not exact quantum dynamics.
methods.original_system: Foundations: quantum/classical ring isomorphism; the early Parrinello–Rahman application is an F center (excess electron) in molten KCl. That electronic model is not a bundled nuclear benchmark.
methods.reproduce_observables: First obtain harmonic position variance, kinetic/potential/total energy and P convergence against analytic quantum values. Then compare water RDF and energy under a specified water model. Report effective sample sizes and independent-seed uncertainty.
methods.gaps: Do not call a harmonic regression a reproduction of the molten-KCl paper. Exact original Hamiltonians and parameter files must be matched for a molecular reproduction.
methods.name_zh: 原始可区分粒子 PIMD
methods.scope_zh: 闭合环聚合物平衡采样；采样时间不是精确量子实时间。
methods.original_system_zh: 理论源于量子—经典环聚合物同构；早期 PIMD 原文研究熔融 KCl 中的 F 中心，并非仓库自带的核动力学体系。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先算谐振子位置方差、动能、势能、总能和珠数收敛；再用指定水模型算 RDF 与能量。
methods.gaps_zh: 谐振子回归不能称为 KCl 论文复现；需要原哈密顿量、参数和独立统计误差。

methods.name: RPMD real-time correlations
methods.scope: Physical-mass ring-polymer propagation approximates Kubo-transformed equilibrium correlation functions; the classical P=1 and harmonic linear-observable limits provide checks.
methods.original_system: Craig–Manolopoulos low-dimensional harmonic/anharmonic model correlation functions.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute C_qq^K(t), its frequency spectrum, short-time error and P/dt convergence against independent quantum diagonalization; include P=1 and exactly solvable harmonic limits.
methods.gaps: Nonlinear observables and long-time quantum coherence are not generally exact. The existing quartic script uses the Cao–Voth model and an independently calculated Kubo reference, not digitized Craig–Manolopoulos data.
methods.name_zh: RPMD 实时间关联函数
methods.scope_zh: 用物理质量环聚合物动力学近似 Kubo 关联；检验 P=1 与谐振子线性可观测量极限。
methods.original_system_zh: Craig–Manolopoulos 的低维谐振/非谐模型关联函数。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 Cqq 的 Kubo 关联、频谱、短时误差以及 P 和时间步收敛，并与独立量子对角化比较。
methods.gaps_zh: 现有四次势脚本是另一个文献模型，不能当成原图复现；非线性量与长时相干不保证精确。

methods.name: Thermal RPMD bimolecular reaction rate
methods.scope: Bennett–Chandler style separation of a centroid free-energy/QTST factor and a dynamical recrossing transmission coefficient, with bimolecular entrance-channel normalization.
methods.original_system: 2005: Eckart/model reactions. 2009: H + H₂, Cl + HCl and F + H₂; the original article has errata, which matter for conventions and reference values.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute W(ξ), barrier position/height, k_QTST, κ(t) plateau, final k(T), isotope ratios where applicable, P/dt/R∞/umbrella-width/window-overlap/parent-child-time convergence and independent replica intervals.
methods.gaps: Use the current validation inventory: H+H₂ has a successful fixed-P128 comparison, while P256 and umbrella-domain checks remain separate gates. Do not promote fixed-P agreement to full convergence. Corrected F+H₂ reference/PES/electronic conventions must be resolved separately.
methods.name_zh: 热平衡 RPMD 双分子反应速率
methods.scope_zh: 质心自由能/QTST 因子乘以动力学回穿系数，并处理入口通道归一化。
methods.original_system_zh: 2005 年 Eckart 等模型；2009 年 H+H₂、Cl+HCl、F+H₂，须同时核对勘误。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 W(ξ)、势垒位置与高度、kQTST、κ(t) 平台和 k(T)；检查 P、dt、入口距离、窗口重叠、亲子轨迹时间和重复采样误差。
methods.gaps_zh: 当前 H+H₂ 的 P128 定珠数比较已通过，但 P256 与伞形采样域仍是独立关卡；F+H₂ 必须匹配修正后的势能面及电子约定。

methods.name: Direct-trajectory thermal RPMD (dRPMD)
methods.scope: Thermally sampled incoming ring polymers followed by direct collision trajectories, cross-section/rate estimation and channel classification.
methods.original_system: The originating application is H₂ + H₃⁺ → H₃⁺ + H₂, resolving direct proton-hop and complex-mediated exchange through H₅⁺.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute reaction probability versus impact parameter/energy, integral cross sections, thermal k(T), direct/complex channel fractions and collision-lifetime distributions. Demonstrate b_max, launch-separation, propagation-time and censoring convergence.
methods.gaps: The bundled H+H₂ case is a practical surrogate. Reproducing the original mechanism transition requires the H₅⁺ PES, isotope/channel labelling and original classifier/conditions; those must be supplied and verified.
methods.name_zh: 直接轨迹热平衡 dRPMD
methods.scope_zh: 热采样入射环聚合物，直接推进碰撞轨迹并统计截面、速率和反应通道。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文是 H₂+H₃⁺，区分直接质子跳跃与经 H₅⁺ 络合物的交换机制。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 P反应(b,E)、积分截面、k(T)、机制分支比、碰撞寿命；检查 bmax、起始距离、轨迹终止和截尾误差。
methods.gaps_zh: 仓库 H+H₂ 是替代验证；原文机制复现还需 H₅⁺ 势能面、通道标记及原始条件。

methods.name: Approximate harmonic initial-state-selected NE-RPMD
methods.scope: Cold harmonic ring preparation plus centroid vibrational excitation and optional j=0 angular-momentum projection. Auxiliary β controls state preparation and is distinct from collision energy or a measured thermal temperature.
methods.original_system: State-selected method papers: Mu/H/D + H₂(v=0,1); polyatomic extension H + CH₄/CHD₃ and F + CHD₃ with C–H-stretch excitation.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute state-specific σ_vj(Ecoll), thresholds, b-dependent probabilities, initial total/vibrational/rotational energy distributions and isolated-reactant stability; converge β, P, dt, b_max and trajectory counts; compare QCT under the same energy definition.
methods.gaps: Initialization implements a harmonic approximation, not an exact arbitrary anharmonic eigenstate. Exact original PES, state definition and temperature-like β must match. Existing reduced trajectory budgets cannot be labelled full paper statistics.
methods.name_zh: 谐振近似初态选择 NE-RPMD
methods.scope_zh: 冷谐振环加质心振动激发，可做 j=0 投影；辅助 β 与碰撞能、热温度不同。
methods.original_system_zh: Mu/H/D+H₂(v=0,1)；多原子扩展为 H+CH₄/CHD₃ 和 F+CHD₃ 的 C–H 伸缩激发。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算态分辨 σvj(E碰撞)、阈值、P(b)、初始能量分布和孤立反应物稳定性；收敛 β、P、dt、bmax 和轨迹数，与同能量定义的 QCT 对照。
methods.gaps_zh: 不是任意非谐本征态的精确制备；小规模试跑不等于原论文完整轨迹统计。

methods.name: Harmonic QCT and full-PES action-matched diatomic QCT
methods.scope: Production QCT uses P=1 harmonic state preparation. The H₃ benchmark additionally solves a one-dimensional full-PES classical action condition J(E)=v+1/2 and samples a time-uniform orbit phase.
methods.original_system: Foundational QCT: H + H₂ on a simple barrier PES. Modern NE-RPMD papers compare with QCT for atom–diatom or methane scattering.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute σ_vj(Ecoll), vibrational action and isolated-energy drift; compare harmonic and action-matched initial energy distributions and scattering under separately labelled fixed-collision-energy and fixed-total-energy protocols.
methods.gaps: Action quantization is semiclassical, not exact quantum eigenstate preparation. Full-PES action initialization is an H₃ diatomic benchmark extension, not a general polyatomic production method. A 1965-paper reproduction requires its historical PES, rather than substituting BKMP2 silently.
methods.name_zh: 谐振 QCT 与全势能面作用量匹配 QCT
methods.scope_zh: 主工作流是 P=1 谐振初态；H₃ 基准另有 J(E)=v+1/2 和按运动时间均匀抽相位的全势能面双原子初始化。
methods.original_system_zh: QCT 奠基应用为简单势垒上的 H+H₂；现代 NE-RPMD 文献也使用 QCT 对照。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算态分辨截面、作用量、孤立能量漂移；分别按固定碰撞能和固定总能比较初态分布与反应结果。
methods.gaps_zh: 作用量量子化是半经典近似；全 PES 版本限 H₃ 双原子基准，不能宣称通用多原子算法或精确本征态。

methods.name: Experimental smooth preparation-to-PES switching diagnostic
methods.scope: Repository-specific diagnostic that changes the preparation Hamiltonian smoothly before scattering; the cited papers supply the surrounding harmonic NE-RPMD context only.
methods.original_system: No originating paper for this exact switching variant was identified. The implemented experiment uses H + H₂.
methods.reproduce_observables: Measure work injected by switching, final reactant energy/action distributions, isolated-reactant stability and σ(E) sensitivity to switching schedule/time. Preserve separate energy labels and compare with harmonic and full-PES-action controls.
methods.gaps: Do not attribute this variant to Marjollet et al. or present it as an established correction that prepares pure quantum states. It is a diagnostic research extension.
methods.name_zh: 实验性平滑切换初态诊断
methods.scope_zh: 仓库自定义的制备哈密顿量到真实 PES 的平滑切换；NE-RPMD 文献仅作背景。
methods.original_system_zh: 没有找到此具体切换变体的原始论文；当前实验体系为 H+H₂。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算切换做功、末态能量/作用量分布、孤立稳定性及截面对切换时长和曲线的敏感性。
methods.gaps_zh: 不得归为已有文献方法，也不能声称保证纯量子态或修正 NE-RPMD 的已知误差。

methods.name: Velocity Verlet, normal-mode BAB and Cayley BCB
methods.scope: Deterministic physical-mass ring-polymer integrators: direct Verlet, analytic free-ring normal-mode BAB, and strongly stable Cayley BCB.
methods.original_system: Verlet reference: small water clusters. Cayley paper: harmonic, weakly anharmonic and quartic one-dimensional oscillators; PILE paper supplies normal-mode splitting context.
methods.reproduce_observables: Plot stable-trajectory fraction, energy error/drift and reversibility error versus dt and P on the paper's one-dimensional models; verify P=1 and free-ring limits. Report force-evaluation cost separately from accuracy.
methods.gaps: Cayley stability does not imply zero time-step bias or exact anharmonic sampling. Match each paper's potential and β before reproducing a figure; routine harmonic regressions are distinct.
methods.name_zh: 速度 Verlet、正常模 BAB 与 Cayley BCB
methods.scope_zh: 物理质量的确定性环聚合物推进；分别使用直接 Verlet、解析自由环和 Cayley 自由环。
methods.original_system_zh: Verlet 参考为小水团簇；Cayley 原文使用谐振、弱非谐和四次振子。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 画稳定轨迹比例、能量误差/漂移及可逆性误差随 dt、P 的变化；核验 P=1 和自由环极限。
methods.gaps_zh: 稳定不等于无时间步偏差；论文图复现必须匹配原势能和 β。

methods.name: BAOAB and Cayley BCOCB
methods.scope: Symmetric Langevin splittings. In BCOCB each C half-step is the square root of the full-step Cayley map, not Cayley evaluated at dt/2.
methods.original_system: BAOAB: model oscillators and alanine dipeptide. BCOCB: harmonic/anharmonic models and 32-molecule q-TIP4P/F water at 298 K, density 0.998 g cm−3.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare finite-dt configurational covariance, kinetic-energy estimates, autocorrelation time and stable fraction across P/dt. For original water target compare kinetic-energy bead convergence and IR time-step sensitivity with the identical force field.
methods.gaps: Current Torch BCOCB rejects MTS inner_steps>1. Thermostat choice and timestep error must be stated; different splitting sequences should not be conflated.
methods.name_zh: BAOAB 与 Cayley BCOCB
methods.scope_zh: 对称 Langevin 劈分；BCOCB 的 C 半步是整步 Cayley 映射的平方根。
methods.original_system_zh: BAOAB 使用振子及丙氨酸二肽；BCOCB 包含 298 K、0.998 g/cm³ 的 32 分子 q-TIP4P/F 水。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 比较构型协方差、动能、相关时间、稳定性随 P/dt 的变化；原水体系再比动能珠数收敛和 IR 时间步敏感性。
methods.gaps_zh: Torch BCOCB 不支持 inner_steps>1 的 MTS；必须报告具体劈分与温控选择。

methods.name: Andersen, Cartesian Langevin and stochastic velocity rescaling
methods.scope: Andersen global Maxwell redraw with an explicit discrete collision clock; exact OU Cartesian Langevin bath; global canonical stochastic velocity rescaling including sign and zero-energy branches.
methods.original_system: The source studies introduce/test canonical thermostats using model/Lennard-Jones systems; the SVR paper includes TIP4P water phases.
methods.reproduce_observables: Verify kinetic-energy chi-square statistics and mean/variance, harmonic configurational covariance, autocorrelation/equilibration versus coupling time, and invariant distributions across dt. Include zero-energy and momentum-DOF conventions.
methods.gaps: Sampling thermostats alter time correlations: use the production-dynamics protocol appropriate to the observable. PyRPMD's global discrete Andersen schedule is a documented implementation variant, not identical to every collision scheme in the original paper.
methods.name_zh: Andersen、Cartesian Langevin 与随机速度缩放温控
methods.scope_zh: 分别实现全局 Maxwell 重抽样、精确 OU 热浴及包含符号和零动能分支的正则速度缩放。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文使用模型/Lennard-Jones 体系；SVR 包含 TIP4P 水的相态测试。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算动能卡方分布、均值方差、谐振构型协方差及相关/平衡时间，检查耦合强度与 dt 敏感性。
methods.gaps_zh: 温控会改变动力学关联；全局离散 Andersen 碰撞时钟属于具体实现变体。

methods.name: PILE-L and PILE-G normal-mode thermostats
methods.scope: PILE-L uses local mode friction proportional to ring frequency; PILE-G combines internal-mode PILE with global centroid stochastic velocity rescaling. Internal-mode friction follows the ring frequencies; centroid coupling is set separately, rather than inferred from its zero normal-mode frequency.
methods.original_system: Original PILE efficiency tests include water and hydrogen in palladium.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute bead/mode covariance, quantum kinetic/potential energy, integrated autocorrelation time and effective independent samples per force call as P and friction vary. Compare PILE-L/G with the original thermostat baselines.
methods.gaps: An equilibrium distribution check does not establish the molecular acceleration reported in the paper. Original water/Pd PES and sampling settings must be matched; PILE production is not automatically RPMD real-time dynamics.
methods.name_zh: PILE-L 与 PILE-G 正常模温控
methods.scope_zh: PILE-L 按环频率设局域摩擦；PILE-G 对内模用 PILE、质心用全局随机速度缩放。 内模摩擦按环频率设定，质心耦合单独设置，不能从零频模推断质心无热浴。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文效率测试包括水和钯中的氢。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算模协方差、量子动势能、积分相关时间、每次势力调用获得的独立样本数，扫描 P 和摩擦。
methods.gaps_zh: 分布检验不能代替原文的分子体系加速验证；需匹配水/Pd 势能与参数。

methods.name: Nosé–Hoover chain thermostat
methods.scope: Global Nosé–Hoover chain with a three-stage Suzuki–Yoshida composition; Python and native routes share mass/DOF conventions.
methods.original_system: Original harmonic-oscillator and free-particle canonical/ergodicity tests.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute joint coordinate–momentum distribution, kinetic-energy distribution, extended-energy drift and equilibration versus chain length/coupling/substeps; compare analytic oscillator statistics.
methods.gaps: Global-chain settings must be converged; deterministic thermostatting alone is not an ergodicity guarantee. Bond-constraint support is not provided for this route.
methods.name_zh: Nosé–Hoover 链温控
methods.scope_zh: 全局链加三阶段 Suzuki–Yoshida 组合；Python/native 共用质量和自由度约定。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文谐振子和自由粒子的正则/遍历性检验。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算联合相空间分布、动能分布、扩展能漂移，扫描链长、耦合和子步。
methods.gaps_zh: 需核验遍历性与参数收敛；此路线不支持键约束。

methods.name: Cartesian and normal-mode GLE baths
methods.scope: Extended-variable exact OU update with supplied stable drift and covariance matrices; Cartesian GLE, normal-mode GLE and normal-mode GLE plus global centroid SVR are available.
methods.original_system: Original colored-noise thermostat: harmonic-frequency response and selective control of dynamical time scales.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare sampled joint momentum/auxiliary covariance with the Lyapunov target; measure position/energy autocorrelation versus oscillator frequency and matrix parameters; check canonical physical variance.
methods.gaps: Generic GLE matrices are not automatically quantum-correct or optimally tuned. The parameterization and physical/auxiliary covariance conventions must accompany any reproduction.
methods.name_zh: Cartesian/正常模 GLE 热浴
methods.scope_zh: 使用显式稳定漂移矩阵和协方差矩阵的扩展变量 OU 更新，可组合质心 SVR。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文研究按谐振频率选择性调控热浴响应。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 对照 Lyapunov 目标算联合动量/辅助变量协方差，扫描频率下的位置与能量相关时间。
methods.gaps_zh: 任意 GLE 矩阵不自动具备量子修正或最佳采样效率；必须提供参数来源。

methods.name: PIGLET with externally calibrated matrices
methods.scope: NVT normal-mode GLE using externally supplied P-dependent calibrated matrices, matched β and parameter provenance; no built-in calibration table is invented.
methods.original_system: Original first-principles liquid-water structural and nuclear kinetic-energy/momentum-distribution study.
methods.reproduce_observables: With the original calibrated bath, compare kinetic energy and static observables against fully converged PIMD versus P and computational cost; independently verify mode covariance and centroid classical temperature.
methods.gaps: External temperature/bead-specific matrices and the original electronic-structure setup are required. PIGLET NPT is rejected. The paper's transient anisotropic Gaussian momentum estimator is not implemented by selecting this bath.
methods.name_zh: 外部标定矩阵驱动的 PIGLET
methods.scope_zh: NVT 正常模 GLE，要求矩阵分别匹配逆温度 β 和珠数 P 并记录来源；没有内置标定表。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文为第一性原理液态水的结构、核动能和动量分布。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 用原标定热浴比较动能/静态量的珠数与成本收敛，并检验正常模协方差与质心经典温度。
methods.gaps_zh: 需外部矩阵和原电子结构条件；不支持 PIGLET NPT，且未实现论文的瞬态各向异性 Gaussian 动量估计器。

methods.name: Fast-forward Langevin rescale thermostat
methods.scope: Native rescale variant updates momentum magnitude while retaining its direction; it is one variant of the fast-forward Langevin family.
methods.original_system: Original tests: one-dimensional harmonic motion, liquid water and Lennard-Jones polymers.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare canonical distributions and integrated potential-energy autocorrelation versus damping; reproduce strong-damping sampling efficiency against ordinary Langevin, reporting force-call-normalized cost.
methods.gaps: State which FFL variant is used. These are equilibrium-sampling comparisons, not evidence for unperturbed physical transport coefficients.
methods.name_zh: Fast-forward Langevin 的 rescale 变体
methods.scope_zh: native 路线保留动量方向并更新其模长。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文包括一维谐振子、液态水和 Lennard-Jones 聚合物。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 比较正则分布及势能相关时间随阻尼的变化，报告强阻尼下相对普通 Langevin 的采样成本。
methods.gaps_zh: 须注明 rescale 变体；采样加速不能作为真实输运系数的验证。

methods.name: Per-bead SHAKE/RATTLE bond constraints
methods.scope: Position and tangent-momentum constraints on every bead, using the Verlet old-gradient SHAKE displacement and matching momentum impulse followed by RATTLE projection.
methods.original_system: SHAKE original: constrained n-alkane molecular dynamics. RATTLE: velocity-form constrained dynamics.
methods.reproduce_observables: Measure maximum bond and velocity-constraint residual, reversibility, constrained energy drift and dt/tolerance convergence. For physical replication, use the original molecular force field and thermodynamic state.
methods.gaps: Supported route is fixed-cell velocity Verlet with NVE/Andersen and Python fallback; native/Cayley/PILE/barostat combinations are rejected. The supplied zero-potential rigid-water example tests kinematics only, not realistic water or a quantum rigid-rotor/Fixman treatment.
methods.name_zh: 逐珠 SHAKE/RATTLE 键约束
methods.scope_zh: Verlet 旧梯度 SHAKE 位移与动量脉冲，随后做 RATTLE 速度切空间投影。
methods.original_system_zh: SHAKE 原文为受约束正烷烃分子动力学；RATTLE 为速度形式约束算法。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算键长及速度约束残差、可逆性、能量漂移、dt/容差收敛；物理复现需原分子力场。
methods.gaps_zh: 只支持固定胞 VV、NVE/Andersen 的 Python 路线；零势刚性水样例仅验证运动学，不代表真实水或量子刚性转子。

methods.name: Ring-polymer contraction and reversible multiple time stepping
methods.scope: Low-mode bead contraction for a slow correction and two-level r-RESPA fast/slow force propagation. Reference correction means Vslow=Vtarget−Vreference, not a second full target potential.
methods.original_system: RPC original: flexible liquid water with component-specific bead contraction. Modern real/imaginary-time multilevel demonstration: MP2 with DFT reference for the Zundel cation.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute force/energy agreement at Pc=P, observable bias versus contracted beads Pc, energy drift versus inner/outer dt, and wall time/expensive force-call savings. Molecular targets require matched force decomposition and electronic methods.
methods.gaps: Python opt-in APIs, not blanket acceleration of every workflow. Resonance and contraction errors require independent convergence. A cheap harmonic split tests algebra but does not reproduce water/MP2 accuracy.
methods.name_zh: 环聚合物收缩 RPC 与可逆多时间步
methods.scope_zh: 低频珠模式收缩慢力，配合两层 r-RESPA；采用参考势校正方案时，慢势为目标势减参考势。
methods.original_system_zh: RPC 原文为柔性液态水的分项收缩；多级时空步原文包含以 DFT 加速 MP2 的 Zundel 阳离子。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 核验 Pc=P 的力能一致性，算观测量对 Pc 的偏差、内外 dt 能漂移及昂贵力调用节约。
methods.gaps_zh: 是显式 API；需独立控制共振和收缩误差，谐振分项检查不等于原水/MP2 复现。

methods.name: Partially adiabatic centroid molecular dynamics (PA-CMD)
methods.scope: Dedicated PACMDDynamics uses fictitious internal-mode masses and an exact-free BAOAB propagator, retaining physical centroid mass. It is distinct from adding friction to an ordinary physical-mass RPMD trajectory.
methods.original_system: PA-CMD comparison paper: liquid para-H₂ at two state points and ortho-D₂ at one. Existing package benchmark instead uses Cao–Voth's 1993 quartic potential V=q²/2+0.1q⁴ at β=5.
methods.reproduce_observables: For the quartic pilot compute centroid Kubo Cqq(t), peak positions/widths and static moments against independent diagonalization/finite-P transfer matrices; converge P, adiabatic frequency Ω, dt, sampling and trajectory length. Original molecular target adds velocity correlations and diffusion.
methods.gaps: The quartic paper's plotted real quantum correlation is not the independently calculated Kubo reference used here. Full molecular PA-CMD needs the original liquid interaction and state points. Curvature/nonlinear-observable limitations remain.
methods.name_zh: 部分绝热质心分子动力学 PA-CMD
methods.scope_zh: 独立 PACMDDynamics 用内模虚质量、物理质心质量和自由环精确 BAOAB 推进。
methods.original_system_zh: 方法比较原文是液态 para-H₂/ortho-D₂；仓库基准另用 Cao–Voth 1993 的 V=q²/2+0.1q⁴、β=5 四次势。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先算四次势质心 Kubo 关联、频峰/展宽和静态矩，与独立量子结果比较；扫描 P、Ω、dt、统计量。原分子目标再算速度关联及扩散。
methods.gaps_zh: 原四次势论文图是实部量子关联，仓库 Kubo 曲线不是原图；完整液体复现还需原相互作用和状态点。

methods.name: Fast centroid molecular dynamics by force matching
methods.scope: Exports PIMD centroid/mean physical bead forces and fits a conservative local quadratic centroid force model; temperature is part of model provenance. IBI is a separate update building block.
methods.original_system: Original f-CMD study: liquid para-H₂ and ortho-D₂; static structure and dynamical/diffusion comparisons with direct CMD.
methods.reproduce_observables: Report held-out centroid-force error, force conservativity, static centroid distribution, Cqq(t)/velocity correlation, spectral or diffusion error, and speedup against direct PA-CMD under the same temperature and training distribution.
methods.gaps: The supplied local quadratic basis is not a general molecular force field. New nonlinear observables need conditional property models. QCMD, hybrid CMD and fast QCMD are not implemented by these exports/IBI helpers.
methods.name_zh: 力匹配快速质心动力学 f-CMD
methods.scope_zh: 导出质心/珠平均物理力，拟合局域二次保守质心势，并记录训练温度；IBI 只是更新模块。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文为液态 para-H₂ 和 ortho-D₂，比较结构、动力学与扩散。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算留出集力误差、保守性、质心静态分布、关联/频谱或扩散误差，以及相对直接 PA-CMD 的加速。
methods.gaps_zh: 局域二次基不足以代表通用分子势；非线性量需条件属性模型；未实现 QCMD、h-CMD 或 f-QCMD。

methods.name: Experimental f-QCMD for bent triatomic molecules
methods.scope: Bead-averaged bond/angle quasi-centroids for nonperiodic, fixed-topology bent triatomics; iterative Boltzmann inversion of separable correction potentials; classical spectroscopy dynamics with method="f-qcmd" and beads=1. A constrained-PIMD API samples fixed mean internal coordinates for equilibrium research. Real-time adiabatic QCMD and h-CMD are not implemented and fail explicitly.
methods.original_system: Trenins–Willatt–Althorpe 2019: infrared spectra of gas-phase water, liquid water and ice from 150 to 600 K. Fletcher et al. 2021: gas-phase vibrational spectra of water and ammonia against QCMD, and methane against quantum results.
methods.reproduce_observables: Gas-phase water quasi-centroid distributions and IR band positions versus exact quantum or QCMD references; IBI convergence of the correction potentials, bead number, temperature transferability and independent-trajectory uncertainty.
methods.gaps: Only bent triatomics are supported, so ammonia, methane and condensed-phase water from the papers are outside the current geometry. Converged liquid-water IR spectra are not established; the correction model is temperature specific.
methods.name_zh: 弯曲三原子分子的实验性 f-QCMD
methods.scope_zh: 对非周期、固定拓扑的弯曲三原子分子，用珠平均键长/键角定义准质心；以迭代 Boltzmann 反演拟合可分离修正势；光谱工作流以 method="f-qcmd"、beads=1 运行经典动力学。约束 PIMD API 在固定平均内坐标下做平衡采样。实时间绝热 QCMD 与 h-CMD 未实现，会明确报错。
methods.original_system_zh: Trenins–Willatt–Althorpe 2019：150–600 K 下气相水、液态水和冰的红外光谱；Fletcher 等 2021：气相水和氨与 QCMD 参考比较、甲烷与量子结果比较的振动光谱。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 气相水的准质心分布与红外谱带位置，对照精确量子或 QCMD 参考；修正势 IBI 收敛、珠数、温度可迁移性与独立轨迹误差。
methods.gaps_zh: 只支持弯曲三原子分子，论文中的氨、甲烷和凝聚相水超出当前几何范围；尚未得到收敛的液态水红外光谱；修正模型只适用于拟合温度。

methods.name: TRPMD dynamics and relative IR spectra
methods.scope: Internal-mode friction with an unthermostatted centroid; relative IR is derived from dipole Kubo correlations with the βω² convention and no extra harmonic quantum correction.
methods.original_system: Original TRPMD tests include harmonic and Morse OH, methane and liquid q-TIP4P/F water. The water comparison uses 216 molecules at 300 K; the Morse oscillator offers a smaller first molecular target.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute dipole Cμμ(t), IR peak position/width/intensity ratios and friction dependence; show removal of ring-polymer resonances versus RPMD while quantifying broadening; converge P/dt/time/window/replicas. Harmonic regression precedes Morse OH, then water.
methods.gaps: TRPMD is approximate and can broaden peaks. Output is relative, without absolute electromagnetic/volume/refractive-index factors. Water09 PA-CMD and TRPMD14 spectra are different targets; selecting TRPMD does not reproduce PA-CMD.
methods.name_zh: TRPMD 与相对红外频谱
methods.scope_zh: 内模摩擦、质心不温控；按 βω² 的 Kubo 偶极关联算相对 IR，不再叠加谐振量子修正。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文含谐振/Morse OH、甲烷和 300 K 的 216 分子 q-TIP4P/F 水；可从 Morse OH 开始。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算偶极关联、峰位/峰宽/强度比和摩擦依赖，对比 RPMD 共振与 TRPMD 展宽；收敛 P、dt、时长、窗函数和独立重复。
methods.gaps_zh: 输出缺绝对光谱归一化；TRPMD 与 2009 水模型论文中的 PA-CMD 不是同一方法目标。

methods.name: TRPMD rate-comparison mode
methods.scope: Optional internally thermostatted rate trajectories supply a friction-sensitivity comparison; rate dynamics must state the selected friction protocol.
methods.original_system: Original assessment: H+H₂, D+MuH, H+CH₄ and F+H₂, comparing rates above and below crossover.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare κ(t) and final k(T) versus internal friction at temperatures on both sides of Tc, with matched PMF and independent uncertainty. Separate friction bias from recrossing statistics.
methods.existing_entry: docs/trpmd-spectroscopy.md; docs/science.md; existing RPMD rate workflow with explicitly selected TRPMD configuration
methods.gaps: TRPMD friction is not a controlled error estimate for exact quantum rates, especially below crossover. Do not use thermostat-insensitive equilibrium tests as rate validation.
methods.name_zh: TRPMD 速率对照模式
methods.scope_zh: 可用内模温控轨迹检查速率对摩擦的敏感性。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文 H+H₂、D+MuH、H+CH₄、F+H₂，比较交叉温度上下的速率。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 用一致 PMF 比较 κ(t) 与 k(T) 对摩擦的依赖，覆盖 Tc 两侧并分离统计误差。
methods.gaps_zh: 摩擦扫描不是精确量子速率的误差界；平衡采样检验不能验证速率。

methods.name: Relative isotropic/anisotropic Raman spectra
methods.scope: Polarizability-tensor correlations decomposed into isotropic and traceless anisotropic invariants; VV=45iso+4aniso, VH=3aniso, total=45iso+7aniso. Optional Kubo-to-Stokes and laser-frequency factors are explicit.
methods.original_system: Kubo provides the original linear-response basis. Dundas et al. supplies the explicit invariant convention in the documentation, with acetone in molecular environments; it is not the historical origin of Raman scattering theory.
methods.reproduce_observables: First test a synthetic harmonic polarizability model with analytic peaks, tensor rotations, depolarization ratio and temperature/laser factors. A molecular reproduction then needs the original PES, polarizability model and environment treatment.
methods.gaps: This is a relative correlation-spectrum implementation, not Dundas et al.'s polarizable-embedding electronic-structure method. A unique original-paper molecular reproduction cannot be claimed from a formula citation alone; absolute experimental cross sections require further prefactors.
methods.name_zh: 各向同性/各向异性相对 Raman 光谱
methods.scope_zh: 极化率张量关联分解为标量与无迹张量，明确 VV/VH 权重、Kubo→Stokes 及激光频率因子。
methods.original_system_zh: 原理引用 Kubo 线性响应；Dundas 等仅是当前不变量公式约定来源，其研究环境中的丙酮，并非 Raman 理论最早来源。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先用解析谐振极化率模型检查峰位、旋转不变性、退偏比与温度/激光因子；再配原 PES、极化率模型和环境做分子目标。
methods.gaps_zh: 没有实现该公式来源论文的极化嵌入电子结构；相对谱不能直接作为绝对实验截面。

methods.name: Relative SFG susceptibility from time correlations
methods.scope: Causal dipole–polarizability response R(t)=−βdCμα(t)/dt and complex susceptibility using the documented positive-frequency transform; signed Imχ and coherent replica averaging are retained.
methods.original_system: Original time-dependent theory: water–vapor interfacial SFG.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute tensor χijk(ω), signed Imχ and coherent |χ|²; verify causal transform/sign with analytic signals. Molecular target: matched water interface, dipole/polarizability surfaces, orientational convention and polarization components.
methods.gaps: The package supplies a relative response kernel; interface/lab-frame axes, Fresnel/local-field factors, beam geometry, normalization and electronic background are caller responsibilities. Do not claim the entire Morita–Hynes water model is implemented.
methods.name_zh: 基于时间关联的相对 SFG 响应
methods.scope_zh: 由偶极—极化率关联构造因果 R(t)=−βdC/dt，保留带符号 Imχ 和复振幅相干平均。
methods.original_system_zh: Morita–Hynes 原文为水—汽界面的时间相关 SFG 理论。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先用解析信号核验 χijk、Imχ、|χ|² 的变换和符号；原体系需水界面、属性面及偏振方向一致。
methods.gaps_zh: 只实现相对响应核；Fresnel/局域场、光路、归一化与电子背景由用户提供。

methods.name: Takahashi–Imada trace action and pCN sampling
methods.scope: Primitive or TI closed-path trace action sampled by Gaussian-preserving pCN internal-mode proposals plus centroid Metropolis moves. MC steps are not dynamical time.
methods.original_system: TI original test: harmonic-oscillator trace convergence. pCN is a function-space MCMC construction, not a particular molecular force field.
methods.reproduce_observables: For a confined harmonic oscillator compute partition-function differences and E/Cv versus P, comparing primitive O(P−2) and TI O(P−4) trace behavior; measure acceptance, autocorrelation and independent samples per cost.
methods.gaps: TI fourth-order accuracy applies to the trace and corresponding thermodynamic derivatives, not automatically off-diagonal density matrices or arbitrary structural observables. It is not a modified physical potential for RPMD. Current API excludes PBC, exchange, frozen atoms and mass-dependent PES.
methods.name_zh: Takahashi–Imada 迹作用量与 pCN 采样
methods.scope_zh: 原始/TI 闭合路径迹作用量，以内模 pCN 和质心 Metropolis 采样；MC 步不是实时间。
methods.original_system_zh: TI 原文的谐振子迹收敛；pCN 来自函数空间 MCMC。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算谐振子配分函数差、E/Cv 的珠数收敛，比较原始 P⁻² 和 TI P⁻⁴，并报告接受率和相关时间。
methods.gaps_zh: TI 高阶性质限迹及相应热力学导数，不自动覆盖结构量或开路径；此 API 不支持 PBC、交换、冻结原子及质量依赖 PES。

methods.name: Quantum kinetic energy, total energy and heat capacity
methods.scope: Thermodynamic β derivatives of the chosen trace action, kinetic estimators and optional scaled-coordinate finite-difference virial estimation; correlated-sample uncertainty is handled by blocks.
methods.original_system: Yamamoto original: (H₂)₂₂ and Ne₁₃ quantum clusters with fourth-order propagators.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute E(T), Cv(T), kinetic and potential contributions with analytic oscillator oracles; compare derivative step sizes, P extrapolation, estimator variance and autocorrelation. Original cluster target needs the precise pair potentials and cluster ensemble.
methods.gaps: Report the action and estimator together; physical kinetic energy is not fictitious ring-polymer momentum temperature. Cluster heat capacities and phase behavior cannot be validated by a single harmonic run.
methods.name_zh: 量子动能、总能与热容估计器
methods.scope_zh: 对指定迹作用量取 β 导数，并可使用缩放坐标有限差分 virial 估计及分块误差。
methods.original_system_zh: Yamamoto 原文为 (H₂)₂₂ 与 Ne₁₃ 量子团簇。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 E(T)、Cv(T)、动势能分解，检查有限差分步长、P 外推、方差与相关时间；团簇需原势能和系综。
methods.gaps_zh: 必须同时注明作用量与估计器；物理量子动能不能用虚拟环动量温度代替。

methods.name: Isotope free-energy and fractionation estimators
methods.scope: Thermodynamic and scaled-coordinate FEP mass substitutions, two-environment fractionation ratios and kinetic-energy thermodynamic integration over mass, with overlap diagnostics.
methods.original_system: 2013: H/D and oxygen isotope effects in liquid water/vapor. 2014: direct fractionation estimators demonstrated for Zundel cation and simple hydrocarbons.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute ΔF(m→m′), ln α between environments and kinetic-energy mass integrals. Compare direct/FEP and intermediate-mass integration, effective sample size, log-weight variance and confidence intervals; use harmonic mass dependence as the first oracle.
methods.gaps: Poor-overlap reweighting is not rescued by a small formal standard error. Current trace-action restrictions limit direct reuse for a periodic liquid-water reproduction; original PES/phase conventions and mass-dependent corrections must be supplied.
methods.name_zh: 同位素自由能与分馏估计
methods.scope_zh: 热力学/缩放坐标 FEP、两环境分馏比及沿质量的动能热力学积分，并检查权重重叠。
methods.original_system_zh: 2013 年为水/汽 H/D 和氧同位素；2014 年包括 Zundel 阳离子与简单烃。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 ΔF、lnα、质量积分；比较 FEP 与中间质量路线，报告有效样本数、对数权重方差和误差。
methods.gaps_zh: 重叠差不能靠形式上的小误差补救；当前迹作用量限制阻碍直接周期液水复现。

methods.name: Primitive open-path one-component momentum distribution
methods.scope: Direct primitive open-chain endpoint-separation sampling and Fourier estimation of one Cartesian component of n(p), with KDE/block-jackknife diagnostics.
methods.original_system: Foundational off-diagonal density-matrix relation; Lin et al. is a related original displaced-path formulation tested on one-dimensional models, water and ice, whose free-energy algorithm is not implemented here.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare open-end separation distribution, Fourier n(p), normalization, symmetry and second moment with analytic harmonic momentum variance; converge P, endpoint sampling, histogram/KDE width and Fourier range, preserving negative/noisy diagnostic values.
methods.gaps: Do not call this Lin et al.'s displaced-path free-energy estimator. It is primitive and one-component, not a full molecular three-dimensional distribution or the PIGLET TAG estimator; no clipping/renormalization should hide undersampling.
methods.name_zh: 原始开路径单分量动量分布
methods.scope_zh: 直接采样开链端点位移并 Fourier 得到一个 Cartesian 分量的 n(p)，带 KDE/分块 jackknife 诊断。
methods.original_system_zh: 依据非对角密度矩阵关系；Lin 等的位移路径原文研究一维模型、水和冰，但其自由能算法未在此实现。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 对谐振子比较端点分布、n(p)、归一化、对称性和二阶矩，扫描 P、采样量、核宽和 Fourier 范围。
methods.gaps_zh: 不是 Lin 位移路径法、完整三维动量分布或 PIGLET 的 TAG；不应裁掉负噪声来掩盖采样不足。

methods.name: Finite-difference Suzuki–Chin path integrals
methods.scope: Even-bead alternating Suzuki–Chin weights with force-gradient terms evaluated through symmetric finite differences along F/m. Python supports α in [0,1]; CLI currently restricts α=0.
methods.original_system: Kapil–Behler–Ceriotti: liquid water and ice with a neural-network potential trained to dispersion-corrected hybrid density-functional data.
methods.reproduce_observables: First compare harmonic even-bead position moments/physical potential against exact finite-P and continuum values; verify finite-difference force convergence. Original target: RDF and thermodynamic observables versus P and force-call cost under the identical NN potential.
methods.gaps: SC energy, heat-capacity and pressure estimators and isotropic SC-NPT (src/pyrpmd/suzuki_chin.py) are validated only on a coupled harmonic crystal and an FCC Lennard-Jones model solid. The CLI [path_integral] route still restricts alpha=0, and the original water/ice reproduction requires the original potential.
methods.name_zh: 有限差分 Suzuki–Chin 路径积分
methods.scope_zh: 偶数珠交替权重与沿 F/m 的对称有限差分力梯度；Python 可选 α，CLI 当前限 α=0。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文为色散修正混合 DFT 训练神经网络势的液态水与冰。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先核验谐振子偶珠位置矩、物理势能和有限差分收敛；原体系再算 RDF、热力学量及成本随 P 的变化。
methods.gaps_zh: SC 能量、热容、压力估计器与各向同性 SC-NPT（src/pyrpmd/suzuki_chin.py）只在耦合谐振晶体与 FCC Lennard-Jones 模型固体上验证；CLI [path_integral] 路线仍限 α=0，原文水/冰复现还需原 NN 势。

methods.name: Quadratic-scaling bosonic exchange PIMD
methods.scope: Feldman–Hirshberg O(N²+PN) recurrence for equal-mass exchange groups, using representative cycles and symmetric observables.
methods.original_system: Original papers: trapped two-dimensional ideal/interacting bosons; 2023 also demonstrates large-system scaling and periodic helium. Existing package benchmark targets the published ideal two-dimensional harmonic-trap setting.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute symmetric density and potential/virial-derived total energy versus N, β and P; compare exact canonical ideal-boson recurrence and small-N explicit checks. Measure wall-time scaling and errors per independent replica.
methods.gaps: The representative-cycle potential need not equal a full factorial sum pointwise; compare symmetric ensemble observables. No periodic winding/superfluid estimator. Existing P=36 model agreement uses different thermostat and shorter trajectories than the paper and is not a complete original statistical campaign.
methods.name_zh: 二次复杂度玻色交换 PIMD
methods.scope_zh: 同质量交换组的 Feldman–Hirshberg O(N²+PN) 递推，使用代表循环并测量对称量。
methods.original_system_zh: 二维谐振阱理想/相互作用玻色子；2023 年另有大规模与周期氦测试。仓库已对接二维理想阱。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算对称密度、势能及谐振 virial 总能随 N、β、P 的变化，对照精确正则递推并测量时间复杂度。
methods.gaps_zh: 逐点势不必等于全排列和；只比较对称系综量。未实现周期绕数/超流估计，仓库温控与采样长度也不同于原文。

methods.name: Primitive positive-trial path-integral ground state (PIGS)
methods.scope: Odd-bead open chain with endpoint half-potential weights and a positive Gaussian or supplied positive trial wavefunction; midpoint observables estimate the projected ground state.
methods.original_system: Original PIGS applications: He₂Cl₂ cluster and liquid/solid ⁴He.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute midpoint position moments and physical potential energy versus projection length, imaginary-time spacing and trial width; compare analytic harmonic ground-state moments. Original helium target adds energy/structure with the original pair potentials and trial ansatz.
methods.gaps: The auxiliary β=Pτ parameterizes projection and is not a physical temperature. Current workflow has no combined bosonic-exchange/PBC production route and no complete original helium energy estimator; do not claim helium reproduction from harmonic examples.
methods.name_zh: 正试探波函数的原始 PIGS
methods.scope_zh: 奇数珠开链、端点半势权重和正 Gaussian/自定义正试探波函数；中点测量投影基态。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文研究 He₂Cl₂ 团簇与液/固 ⁴He。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 扫描投影长度、虚时间间距、试探宽度，算中点位置矩与物理势能并对照谐振基态；氦体系需原势和试探函数。
methods.gaps_zh: 辅助 β 不是物理温度；没有 PBC+玻色交换组合生产流程及完整原氦能量估计器。

methods.name: Ring-polymer instanton thermal rate
methods.scope: Stationary imaginary-time ring optimization, semiclassical fluctuation determinant/prefactor, harmonic-reactant normalization and negative/zero-mode checks; multidimensional gas-rate handling includes declared rigid-body external modes.
methods.original_system: 2009 connection paper: symmetric/asymmetric one-dimensional Eckart barrier tests. 2016 paper supplies first-principles instanton-rate derivation.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute Tc, optimized path/action, gradient residual, Hessian signature, fluctuation prefactor and k(T); converge beads, optimization tolerance and finite-difference Hessian; compare one-dimensional Eckart against numerical quantum transmission integration away from crossover.
methods.gaps: Optimization success is not physical convergence; reports retain physical_converged=False. Dense Hessian size is bounded. A molecular claim also needs the matching PES, reactant partition functions, symmetry/rotation factors and bead-converged temperatures.
methods.name_zh: 环聚合物瞬子热速率
methods.scope_zh: 优化驻定虚时间路径，计算半经典涨落行列式/前因子、谐振反应物归一化及负/零模；气相速率可声明外部刚体模。
methods.original_system_zh: 2009 年包含对称/非对称一维 Eckart 势垒；2016 年提供第一原理推导。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 Tc、路径/作用量、梯度残差、Hessian 符号、前因子及 k(T)，检查珠数/优化/Hessian 差分收敛，与一维精确透射积分比较。
methods.gaps_zh: 优化收敛不代表物理收敛，报告仍保留 physical_converged=False；分子目标还需势面、配分函数、对称/转动因子。

methods.name: Symmetric bound-well instanton tunnelling splitting
methods.scope: Single-kink semiclassical splitting for an isolated symmetric bound or explicitly constrained doublet.
methods.original_system: Original ring-polymer splitting paper: full-dimensional HO₂ and malonaldehyde.
methods.reproduce_observables: First use a one-dimensional symmetric double well: compare instanton action, fluctuation prefactor and ground-doublet Δ against independent Hamiltonian diagonalization; converge projection time, beads and optimization.
methods.gaps: Current splitting code rejects free translational/rotational modes and is not a gas-phase rovibrational splitting or multiwell multiplet implementation. HO₂/malonaldehyde paper replication is therefore an extension target, not a presently turnkey reproduction.
methods.name_zh: 对称束缚双阱的瞬子隧穿劈裂
methods.scope_zh: 单 kink、孤立对称束缚或明确约束双态的半经典劈裂。
methods.original_system_zh: 原文为全维 HO₂ 和丙二醛。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先用一维对称双阱，对照量子对角化的基态双态差 Δ，核验作用量/前因子、投影时间和珠数收敛。
methods.gaps_zh: 当前拒绝自由平移/转动模，不是气相转振劈裂或多阱多重态；原分子复现需扩展。

methods.name: Harmonic TST, Wigner and Eckart cross-checks
methods.scope: Classical and quantum harmonic-TST baselines, leading Wigner tunnelling correction and thermally integrated asymmetric Eckart transmission, with explicitly named ZPE/barrier conventions.
methods.original_system: Original theoretical activated-complex/weak-tunnelling and analytical-barrier papers; Eckart is an analytically defined barrier rather than a specific reactive molecule.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compute classical/quantum harmonic k_TST, κ_Wigner, κ_Eckart and corrected k(T) against direct quadrature; verify high-temperature limit, detailed energy convention, forward/reverse barrier inputs and sensitivity near Tc.
methods.gaps: Wigner is a weak-tunnelling expansion, not a deep-tunnelling method; neither Wigner nor a fitted one-dimensional Eckart barrier establishes multidimensional accuracy or provides a uniform crossover correction.
methods.name_zh: 谐振 TST、Wigner 与 Eckart 对照
methods.scope_zh: 经典/量子谐振 TST、Wigner 低阶修正和非对称 Eckart 透射热积分，并明确零点能/势垒约定。
methods.original_system_zh: 活化络合物、弱隧穿展开和解析势垒的理论原文；Eckart 本身不是特定分子反应。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 kTST、κWigner、κEckart 与修正 k(T)，核验高温极限、正反势垒、能量零点及 Tc 附近敏感性。
methods.gaps_zh: Wigner 不适合深隧穿；一维拟合 Eckart 不证明多维准确性，也不是统一交叉区修正。

methods.name: Umbrella sampling / 1D–3D FES
methods.scope: Static harmonic umbrella biases with full CV Jacobians and explicit ring scaling; US origins are classical Monte Carlo and supply the importance-sampling principle, not an identical PyRPMD dynamics engine.
methods.original_system: The 1974/1977 papers studied the Lennard-Jones fluid, including the vapor-liquid coexistence region; the 1974 work used an inverse-twelve/soft-sphere fluid as its free-energy reference.
methods.reproduce_observables: For the original systems, calculate free-energy differences over temperature and density. First validate this package on analytic 1D/2D/3D harmonic FESs and sampled-support coverage, then the classical OGRe double well.
methods.gaps: Recover the complete LJ parameters, reference path and reference free energy from the original papers. The supplied harmonic examples are implementation regressions, not reproductions of the original LJ calculations.
methods.name_zh: 伞形采样与 1D–3D 自由能面
methods.scope_zh: 实现静态谐和伞势、CV Jacobian 与环聚合物能量缩放。Torrie–Valleau 原论文提供重要性采样原理，不是本包动力学引擎的逐项实现。
methods.original_system_zh: 原始 1974/1977 论文：Lennard–Jones 流体，包含气液共存区；1974 以 inverse-twelve / soft-sphere 流体为自由能参考。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 论文路线算不同温度、密度的自由能差；程序优先算解析谐振子 1D/2D/3D FES 与支持区覆盖率，再算 OGRe 的经典双阱。
methods.gaps_zh: LJ 原论文的完整参数、路径与参考自由能尚需从原文恢复；现成谐振子例子是回归，不是 LJ 论文复现。

methods.name: MBAR free energies, histogram FES, overlap diagnostics
methods.scope: Direct SciPy implementation of MBAR; bins are used only after MBAR to form CV-density FES. Do not rename this as a separately implemented WHAM solver. Bootstrap is the package uncertainty route; original asymptotic covariance is not thereby claimed.
methods.original_system: Optical-tweezer measurements of a DNA hairpin under different constant forces; reconstruction of the potential of mean force along molecular extension.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate state free-energy offsets, target weights, the PMF and overlap matrix. Compare against PyMBAR using exactly the same umbrella samples, then check sampling-length and bin-size convergence.
methods.gaps: The original DNA measurement data are not supplied with the package. Recover the dataset, applied forces and unit conventions separately.
methods.name_zh: MBAR 自由能、直方图 FES 与重叠诊断
methods.scope_zh: 直接以 SciPy 求解 MBAR，再用目标权重生成直方图 FES；不是另一个 WHAM 求解器。当前误差路径是 bootstrap，不能由此声称实现原文全部渐近协方差公式。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文：不同恒定拉力下的 DNA 发夹 optical-tweezer 测量，重构伸长坐标 PMF。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算各状态自由能偏移、目标权重、PMF、重叠矩阵；先在同一批 umbrella 样本与 PyMBAR 做数值一致性，再检查样本和分箱收敛。
methods.gaps_zh: DNA 原始测量数据并未随包提供；应单独恢复数据、拉力和单位。

methods.name: Gaussian umbrella integration
methods.scope: One-dimensional Gaussian window approximation ported mathematically from RPMDrate; it is not the later multidimensional or higher-order UI algorithms.
methods.original_system: The 2005 paper reports an analytic potential function and a biological system. The accessible primary abstract does not name the biological system, so its identity has not been guessed.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate the mean force, PMF and barrier. On identical samples, compare UI/MBAR barriers, Gaussian window fits and support for any tail extrapolation.
methods.gaps: Obtain the 2005 full text to recover the analytic potential parameters and biological model. H+H2/BKMP2 is an existing application benchmark, not the original UI-paper system.
methods.name_zh: 高斯窗口伞形积分
methods.scope_zh: 实现一维高斯窗口近似，并按 RPMDrate 数学形式移植；不包括后续高阶或多维伞形积分。
methods.original_system_zh: 2005 原论文含解析势函数和一个生物体系；本次可读原始摘要未给出生物体系名称，未将猜测写成事实。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算平均力、PMF、势垒；在完全相同样本上比较 UI/MBAR 势垒差、Gaussian 窗口拟合和尾部外推支持。
methods.gaps_zh: 需取得 2005 全文恢复原解析势参数和生物模型。H+H2/BKMP2 是现有应用验证，并非 UI 方法论文原体系。

methods.name: Adaptive umbrella placement and coverage planning
methods.scope: PyRPMD-specific normalized MBAR-overlap graph, midpoint/coverage insertion, fixed stiffness, independent pilot then fresh production. OGRe is a benchmark/model comparison, not the implemented planner; OGRe also uses confinement/consistency and stiffness refinement.
methods.original_system: No single original paper describes the complete PyRPMD planner. The comparator OGRe paper includes 1D/2D analytic models, proton hopping in zeolites and interlayer stacking in COF-5.
methods.reproduce_observables: Start with the OGRe Eq.13 double well and Eq.14 Ackley surface at P=1 and 300 K. Report FES/RMSE, coverage, overlap, window count, total PES calls and independent-seed uncertainty; include all pilot cost.
methods.existing_entry: python benchmarks/fes_methods/ogre_benchmark.py build --output runs/ogre; python benchmarks/fes_methods/ogre_benchmark.py run --model double_well --method adaptive --seed 4101 --output runs/ogre
methods.gaps: Ackley requires a specified normalization domain; the repository wall is part of that model definition. For P>1, a nonharmonic centroid FES is not the bare potential. These calculations do not reproduce the full OGRe planner.
methods.name_zh: 自适应伞窗布置与覆盖规划
methods.scope_zh: 本包以归一化 MBAR 重叠图、窗口中点和覆盖缺口补点，保持刚度；pilot 后重新生成 production。OGRe 仅提供对照模型，其刚度细化和 confinement/consistency 判据未完整实现。
methods.original_system_zh: 没有单一原创论文对应整个 PyRPMD planner。对照论文 OGRe：1D/2D 解析模型、沸石质子跳跃与 COF-5 层间堆垛。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先算 OGRe Eq.13 双阱和 Eq.14 Ackley 的 P=1、300 K FES：PMF/RMSE、覆盖率、重叠、窗口数、总 PES 调用、独立种子误差，所有 pilot 成本计入总成本。
methods.gaps_zh: Ackley 需限定归一化域，仓库外墙属于模型定义；P>1 非谐 centroid FES 不等于裸势。不能据此声称复现 OGRe 完整算法。

methods.name: Standard metadynamics
methods.scope: History-dependent Gaussian bias and finite-time -V free-energy estimate; original 2002 coarse-grained algorithm is the method origin, while deposition occurs directly in the package MD workflow.
methods.original_system: The original paper studied NaCl dissociation in water and alanine-dipeptide conformational changes in aqueous solution.
methods.reproduce_observables: For NaCl, calculate an FES using ion separation and solvent-coordination information. For alanine, calculate F(phi,psi), basin free-energy differences, barriers and convergence histories. First check bias forces and finite-time FESs on the OGRe double well.
methods.gaps: Prepare the same force field, water model and CVs as the original application. Ordinary biased simulation time does not directly provide a physical rate.
methods.name_zh: 标准元动力学
methods.scope_zh: 高斯历史偏置与有限时间 −V 自由能估计。Laio–Parrinello 提供方法起源，本包直接在 MD 工作流沉积偏置。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文：水中 NaCl 解离，以及水溶液 alanine dipeptide 构象变化。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: NaCl 算离子距离/溶剂配位相关 FES；alanine 算 F(phi,psi) 与盆地自由能差、势垒及收敛历史。先用 OGRe 双阱验证偏置力和有限时间 FES。
methods.gaps_zh: 需另外准备同原文 force field、水模型与 CV；普通有偏时间不能直接得到物理速率。

methods.name: Well-tempered metadynamics
methods.scope: Exponentially tempered Gaussian hills; F approaches -gamma/(gamma-1) V. No time-dependent c(t) trajectory reweighting is implemented in bias_fes.
methods.original_system: Alanine dipeptide was used to demonstrate free-energy reconstruction in the original paper.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate F(phi,psi), basin differences and barrier errors versus simulation time, bias factor and deposition parameters. Use independent seeds; hill count alone is not convergence evidence.
methods.gaps: Match the molecular force field, temperature and solvent treatment to the full paper/SI. The supplied harmonic2D example is an implementation regression.
methods.name_zh: 良调元动力学
methods.scope_zh: 按偏置指数衰减 hill 高度，以 −γV/(γ−1) 估计自由能；bias_fes 不实现带 c(t) 的时间依赖轨迹重加权。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文：alanine dipeptide 自由能面。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 F(phi,psi)、盆地差和势垒误差随时间、bias factor 与沉积参数变化；独立种子检查，不把 hill 数量当收敛。
methods.gaps_zh: 论文 molecular force field、温度、溶剂细节需按全文/SI 一致准备；仓库 harmonic2D 是方法回归。

methods.name: Shared-bias multiple-walker metadynamics
methods.scope: Shared Gaussian (MetaD) or kernel (OPES) histories with walkers_mode=serial, mpi-sync (one walker per MPI rank, rank-ordered synchronous batches, one atomic ensemble checkpoint) or async-files (append-only per-walker logs, eventually merged). Walkers sharing one bias are statistically dependent; synchronization and restart specifics are project engineering.
methods.original_system: The original paper studied threading/unthreading of tetracationic cyclobis(paraquat-p-phenylene) and 1,5-dihydroxynaphthalene in acetonitrile, plus Langevin models in 1D/2D/3D spherical wells.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate the 2D FES in center separation and solvent coordination, unthreading/rethreading barriers, FES error and wall time/total simulated time versus walker count. First perform an equal-budget OGRe double-well regression; estimate uncertainty across independent complete shared histories.
methods.gaps: Section 3 and Fig.3 use 300 K and 1–32 walkers; molecular simulation details are delegated to the original paper's ref.35 and must be recovered. Its WHAM-superposition postprocessing is not implemented merely by sharing a bias. Shared walkers are not independent replicates.
methods.name_zh: 共享偏置的多行者元动力学
methods.scope_zh: 以 walkers_mode=serial、mpi-sync（每个 MPI rank 一个行者、按 rank 顺序同步批次、单一原子性系综 checkpoint）或 async-files（每个行者追加日志、最终合并）共享高斯（MetaD）或核（OPES）历史。共享同一偏置的行者在统计上相关；同步与重启协议是项目工程，原文 WHAM superposition 后处理未一并实现。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文：乙腈中四价 cyclobis(paraquat-p-phenylene) 环芳烷与 1,5-dihydroxynaphthalene 的穿脱套过程；另有 1D/2D/3D 球形势阱 Langevin 模型。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算两中心距离和溶剂配位数的二维 FES、脱套/回穿势垒、FES 误差及 wall time/总动力学时间随 walker 数变化；先用 OGRe 双阱做同预算回归，误差来自独立完整共享历史。
methods.gaps_zh: 原文 Section 3 和 Fig.3 为 300 K、1–32 walkers，分子势详情指向其 ref.35，需补齐；原文 WHAM superposition 后处理未随共享偏置功能一并实现。多个 shared walkers 不等于多个独立重复。

methods.name: Grid-accelerated metadynamics and FES projection
methods.scope: Grid interpolation, derivatives, and Boltzmann marginalization implement numerical representations of the existing bias/FES; no separate invented original paper. Domain-masked marginalization is not a literature hill-filtering procedure.
methods.original_system: Use the systems of the standard/WT-metadynamics papers. There is no independent original paper for the PyRPMD grid engineering.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare direct and grid bias energies, forces and FESs under the same trajectory parameters while refining grid spacing. Check nonuniform-bin volume factors and missing-support masks in marginal free energies.
methods.gaps: Grid acceleration and projection consistency do not independently establish physical accuracy. Projected basin weights are not dynamical branching fractions.
methods.name_zh: 网格元动力学与自由能投影
methods.scope_zh: 网格插值、导数和带 bin 体积的 Boltzmann 边际化，是既有偏置与 FES 的数值表示，没有单独原创方法论文；缺失支持的掩膜投影不是 hill filtering。
methods.original_system_zh: 延用标准/WT-MetaD 论文体系；没有独立的 PyRPMD 网格工程原始论文。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在同一轨迹参数下比较 direct/grid 偏置能量与力、FES，扫描网格间距；检查边际自由能的非均匀 bin 体积因子和 missing-support mask。
methods.gaps_zh: 网格速度提升和投影数值一致性不建立独立物理准确性；不可把投影盆地权重用作动力学分支。

methods.name: OPES_METAD / frozen-bias reweighting
methods.scope: Uncompressed normalized wrapped-Gaussian KDE and kernel-center Z; fixed bandwidth default. Optional frozen-bias histogram reweighting uses exp(beta V), not a time-dependent c(t) correction.
methods.original_system: The original paper and SI include a double-well model, alanine dipeptide and alanine tetrapeptide.
methods.reproduce_observables: Begin with double-well comparisons of KDE, bias, forces and normalization Z. Calculate frozen-bias FESs, ESS, coverage and basin free energies before moving to alanine.
methods.gaps: Kernel compression is absent; shared OPES walkers (walkers_mode mpi-sync or async-files) are the samp-walkers entry. Wrapped Gaussian kernels differ from PLUMED's truncated kernels. Cross-code comparisons must match initialization constants, physical kernel widths, normalization and bias gauge.
methods.name_zh: OPES_METAD 与冻结偏置重加权
methods.scope_zh: 默认固定宽度，用未压缩且归一化的周期包裹高斯 KDE 与中心采样 Z 估计；冻结偏置后的直方图用 exp(βV)，不扣时间依赖 c(t)。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文及 SI：double-well 模型、alanine dipeptide、alanine tetrapeptide。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 从 double well 做 KDE、bias、force 与归一化 Z 对照；算冻结偏置后的 FES、ESS、覆盖率和盆地自由能，再移至 alanine。
methods.gaps_zh: 无 kernel compression；共享 OPES 行者（walkers_mode 为 mpi-sync 或 async-files）见 samp-walkers 条目；wrapped Gaussian 与 PLUMED 截断 kernel 不完全相同。跨码比较须统一初始化常数、实际 kernel 宽度、归一化和偏置 gauge。

methods.name: OPES-explore and optional adaptive widths
methods.scope: Explore uses unweighted sampled-target KDE and prefactor (gamma-1)/beta. Optional Welford/Scott-ESS widths are an explicit PyRPMD rule, not PLUMED diffusion-window bandwidth adaptation.
methods.original_system: The original paper uses the Müller potential, alanine dipeptide and alanine tetrapeptide to study exploration and FES convergence with incomplete CVs.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate interbasin transitions, FES error and coverage versus time. Separately compare metad/explore modes and fixed/adaptive widths. Faster exploration does not imply FES convergence.
methods.existing_entry: pyrpmd run examples/opes/adaptive_explore.inp --output runs/adaptive-explore; python benchmarks/tier2_literature/sampling.py opes --output runs/tier2-sampling
methods.gaps: tier2_literature/sampling.py already includes the published Müller model and x/y CV comparisons, but its default budget is not the original 200-million-step budget. Its adaptive-width rule is a package-specific comparison, not a full reproduction of PLUMED OPES.
methods.name_zh: OPES-explore 与可选自适应宽度
methods.scope_zh: explore 使用等权目标分布 KDE 与 (γ−1)/β 系数。可选 Welford/Scott-ESS 宽度更新是本包明确规则，区别于 PLUMED diffusion-window 规则。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文：Müller potential、alanine dipeptide 与 alanine tetrapeptide；用不充分 CV 研究探索速度与 FES 收敛之间的关系。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算跨盆地次数、FES 误差、覆盖率随时间；分别比较 metad/explore 和 fixed/adaptive widths。探索更快不能当成 FES 已收敛。
methods.gaps_zh: tier2_literature/sampling.py 已包含论文 Müller 模型及 x/y CV 对照，但默认预算不等于原文 200M steps；自适应规则只能做本实现的对照，不能声称完整复现 PLUMED OPES。

methods.name: Variationally enhanced sampling (VES) on centroid CVs
methods.scope: fes.method="ves" optimizes a tensor-product Legendre linear bias on one or two nonperiodic centroid CVs by averaged stochastic gradient descent with the full covariance Hessian. Uniform or well-tempered targets use Gauss–Legendre quadrature; frozen-bias production and reweighting write the common FESResult. Not a PLUMED VES bridge; other basis sets, periodic CVs, barostats and replica exchange are not combined with it.
methods.original_system: Valsson–Parrinello 2014 introduce the variational functional and demonstrate it on numerical examples, including a three-dimensional free-energy surface; the 2015 paper adds the well-tempered target. Their molecular systems and protocols were not re-extracted for this entry.
methods.reproduce_observables: First compare converged biases and FES for the analytic double well and the 2D well-tempered example with quadrature and MBAR references. Then report FES error against basis order, quadrature order, pace and learning rate, coefficient trajectories and frozen-bias effective sample size over independent seeds.
methods.gaps: Recover the original molecular systems before claiming a reproduction. The bundled inputs are toy models in electron-mass units at artificial temperatures; basis and quadrature resolution must be re-established for each system, and the finite CV box truncates the target.
methods.name_zh: 质心 CV 上的变分增强采样（VES）
methods.scope_zh: fes.method="ves" 在一或两个非周期质心 CV 上优化张量积 Legendre 线性偏置，采用带完整协方差 Hessian 的平均随机梯度下降；均匀或 well-tempered 目标用 Gauss–Legendre 积分；冻结偏置生产与重加权输出通用 FESResult。不是 PLUMED VES 接口，不与其他基组、周期 CV、压浴或副本交换组合。
methods.original_system_zh: Valsson–Parrinello 2014 提出变分泛函，并用包括三维自由能面在内的数值例子演示；2015 年论文加入 well-tempered 目标分布。本条目未重新提取原文分子体系与协议。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先在解析双阱和二维 well-tempered 例子中，将收敛偏置与 FES 同积分及 MBAR 参考比较；再报告 FES 误差随基组阶数、积分阶数、pace 和学习率的变化、系数轨迹以及冻结偏置的有效样本数（独立种子）。
methods.gaps_zh: 宣称复现前需先恢复原文分子体系。仓库输入是电子质量单位、人工温度的玩具模型；每个体系都要重新确定基组与积分分辨率，有限 CV 盒子会截断目标分布。

methods.name: Centroid ABF and extended-system ABF with CZAR
methods.scope: fes.method="abf"/"eabf" on one or two nonperiodic centroid CVs with full-row-rank Jacobians. The local mean force uses the full-ring Jacobian and a mass-weighted dual field with a linear ramp; 1D edge integration or 2D least-squares Helmholtz projection gives the FES. eABF biases harmonically coupled fictitious variables and reconstructs the FES with CZAR. Requires all atoms mobile and a canonical thermostat; fixed atoms, periodic cells/CVs, pressure coupling, replica exchange and the rate-flux measure are rejected.
methods.original_system: Darve–Pohorille 2001 introduce the average-force method; Darve et al. 2008 use the Phi/Psi backbone dihedrals of N-acetylalanyl-N'-methylamide as the numerical example. Alrachid–Lelièvre 2015 is a convergence analysis; the eABF/CZAR application systems of Lesage et al. 2017 were not re-extracted for this entry.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare 1D/2D FES from ABF and eABF/CZAR with quadrature, umbrella/MBAR and independent replica spread on the bundled double well; report grid resolution, ramp, update interval and coupling-constant sensitivity, and the 2D projection residual.
methods.gaps: The alanine-dipeptide force field and protocols of the original papers are not bundled. A single history has no uncertainty; replica spread is descriptive. Rank-deficient points are rejected rather than handled by a singular-coordinate estimator.
methods.name_zh: 质心 ABF 与扩展系统 ABF（CZAR）
methods.scope_zh: fes.method="abf"/"eabf" 适用于一或两个非周期、Jacobian 行满秩的质心 CV。局部平均力由全环 Jacobian 与带线性 ramp 的质量加权对偶场给出；一维沿边积分、二维最小二乘 Helmholtz 投影得到 FES。eABF 对谐振耦合的虚拟变量施加偏置，并用 CZAR 重构 FES。要求全部原子可动并使用正则热浴；拒绝固定原子、周期胞/CV、压浴、副本交换和速率通量测度。
methods.original_system_zh: Darve–Pohorille 2001 提出平均力方法；Darve 等 2008 以 N-acetylalanyl-N'-methylamide 的 Phi/Psi 主链二面角为数值例子；Alrachid–Lelièvre 2015 为收敛性分析；本条目未重新提取 Lesage 等 2017 的 eABF/CZAR 应用体系。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在仓库双阱上将 ABF 和 eABF/CZAR 的一维/二维 FES 与积分、伞形/MBAR 以及独立副本离散度比较；报告网格分辨率、ramp、更新间隔、耦合常数的敏感性及二维投影残差。
methods.gaps_zh: 未提供原文丙氨酸二肽的力场与协议；单条历史没有误差估计，副本离散度只是描述性的；秩亏点被拒绝，未实现奇异坐标估计。

methods.name: Steered centroid MD and nonequilibrium work estimators
methods.scope: fes.method="steered" moves a harmonic centroid restraint forward and/or backward and estimates the restrained endpoint free-energy difference with Jarzynski or the Crooks/Bennett acceptance-ratio equation. Work uses H_P/P; total work is protocol work plus finite-step shadow work, and bath heat is excluded. No FESResult grid is produced; Hummer–Szabo unbiased-PMF reconstruction is not implemented.
methods.original_system: Jarzynski 1997 and Crooks 1999 are general nonequilibrium-work identities; Bennett 1976 is the two-ensemble acceptance-ratio estimator; Sivak–Chodera–Crooks 2013 interpret finite-timestep Langevin error as shadow work. No single original simulation system is attached.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare forward Jarzynski and bidirectional Crooks/BAR estimates of the restrained endpoint free-energy difference with exact quadrature for harmonic and double-well models; report bias against pulling speed, work-distribution overlap, bootstrap intervals and the shadow-work correction against timestep.
methods.gaps: The estimate is a restrained endpoint free-energy difference, not an unbiased PMF. Fast pulling makes exponential work averages converge poorly; check work-distribution overlap and repeat with independent seeds.
methods.name_zh: 质心拉伸动力学（steered MD）与非平衡功估计
methods.scope_zh: fes.method="steered" 沿正向和/或反向移动质心谐振约束，用 Jarzynski 或 Crooks/Bennett 接受比方程估计受约束端点间的自由能差。功按 H_P/P 计，总功 = 协议功 + 有限步长 shadow work，不含热浴热量。不生成 FESResult 网格，未实现 Hummer–Szabo 无偏 PMF 重构。
methods.original_system_zh: Jarzynski 1997 与 Crooks 1999 是通用非平衡功恒等式；Bennett 1976 给出双系综接受比估计；Sivak–Chodera–Crooks 2013 把有限步长 Langevin 误差解释为 shadow work。没有唯一的原始模拟体系。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在谐振子与双阱模型上，把单向 Jarzynski 和双向 Crooks/BAR 的受约束端点自由能差与精确积分比较；报告偏差随拉伸速度的变化、功分布重叠、bootstrap 区间及 shadow-work 修正随步长的变化。
methods.gaps_zh: 结果是受约束端点自由能差，不是无偏 PMF；快速拉伸时指数功平均收敛很差，需检查功分布重叠并用独立种子重复。

methods.name: Same-temperature replica-exchange umbrella sampling
methods.scope: Fixed-window, same-temperature 1D/2D REUS swaps full rings; sampling measure includes P*umbrella energy at beta/P. No automatic temperature exchange in this workflow.
methods.original_system: The original multidimensional exchange paper uses alanine trimer capped by acetyl and N-methyl groups, an all-atom AMBER potential and distance-dependent dielectric; the O1–H5 distance is the reaction coordinate.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate the distance PMF, helical/turn/extended populations, exchange acceptance, walker round trips and joint window autocorrelation. Compare with ordinary umbrella sampling at equal total cost.
methods.gaps: The supplied example is harmonic; the original peptide force field and geometry need separate preparation. Exchanged trajectories serve equilibrium sampling and cannot be used as physical RPMD dynamical correlation times.
methods.name_zh: 同温伞形采样副本交换
methods.scope_zh: 固定一维/二维伞窗间交换完整环构型，使用 β/P 测度和 P 倍伞势；该工作流不进行温度交换。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文：N 端 acetyl、C 端 N-methyl 封端的 alanine trimer，AMBER 全原子势与 distance-dependent dielectric；反应坐标为 O1-H5 距离。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算距离 PMF、helical/turn/extended 概率、交换接受率、walker round trips 与窗口联合自相关；与相同总预算普通 umbrella 比较。
methods.gaps_zh: 现成例子为 harmonic 模型，原肽势/构型要另配；交换后的时间只用于采样，不能作真实 RPMD 相关时间。

methods.name: Temperature / Hamiltonian replica-exchange API
methods.scope: Serial Python engine; ring exchange evaluates the target-temperature spring action and rescales momenta. The resumable [tempering] input workflow with checkpoints and MPI transport is the separate samp-tempering entry.
methods.original_system: The 1999 REMD paper uses the Met-enkephalin pentapeptide; the 2000 multidimensional extension uses capped alanine trimer.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate energy distributions and conformational populations in temperature/Hamiltonian slots, exchange detailed balance and round trips. For P>1, additionally verify spring-action exchange factors and exact harmonic distributions.
methods.gaps: Ring-polymer exchange at P>1 applies the classical exchange principle to this package's measure. Original molecular potentials, temperature ladders and initial states require separate preparation.
methods.name_zh: 温度与哈密顿量副本交换 API
methods.scope_zh: 串行 Python 引擎，对目标温度重新计算环弹簧作用并缩放动量；带 checkpoint 与 MPI 的可续跑 [tempering] 输入工作流见单独条目 samp-tempering。
methods.original_system_zh: 1999 REMD 原论文：Met-enkephalin 五肽；2000 多维扩展：blocked alanine trimer。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算温度/哈密顿量槽位的能量分布、构象概率、交换 detailed balance、round trips；P>1 额外验证 spring-action 交换因子与精确 harmonic 分布。
methods.gaps_zh: P>1 的 ring 交换属于把经典交换原理用于本包测度；需另配论文分子势、温度梯和初态。

methods.name: Resumable parallel tempering and Hamiltonian replica-exchange workflow
methods.scope: The [tempering] table for task="pimd" and selected task="fes" inputs: explicit or geometric temperature ladders and Hamiltonian ladders. Exchanges evaluate all-state reduced potentials, including each target-temperature spring action, and rescale momenta by sqrt(beta_i/beta_j). Per-state archives, acceptance, round trips, state-space diffusion and MBAR overlap; PIMD estimators are recomputed for every target state. Serial, process and MPI transports share one ordering; independent of same-temperature [replica_exchange] REUS.
methods.original_system: Hukushima–Nemoto 1996: three-dimensional ±J Ising spin glass. Sugita–Okamoto 1999: Met-enkephalin. Sugita–Kitao–Okamoto 2000: capped alanine trimer.
methods.reproduce_observables: On the bundled double well, compare per-temperature distributions and estimators with exact references; report adjacent acceptance, round trips, state-space mean-square displacement and MBAR overlap, and verify bitwise restart and MPI equality.
methods.gaps: Exchange improves state mixing but does not turn PIMD sampling time into dynamics; results keep converged=false. The original spin-glass and peptide models, ladders and force fields require separate preparation.
methods.name_zh: 可续跑的并行回火与哈密顿量副本交换工作流
methods.scope_zh: [tempering] 用于 task="pimd" 与部分 task="fes" 输入：显式或几何温度梯以及哈密顿量梯。交换计算所有状态的约化势（含各目标温度的环弹簧作用），动量按 sqrt(beta_i/beta_j) 缩放。按状态保存轨迹，报告接受率、往返、状态空间扩散与 MBAR 重叠；PIMD 估计量对每个目标状态重新计算。串行、进程与 MPI 执行顺序一致；与同温 [replica_exchange] REUS 相互独立。
methods.original_system_zh: Hukushima–Nemoto 1996：三维 ±J Ising 自旋玻璃；Sugita–Okamoto 1999：Met-enkephalin；Sugita–Kitao–Okamoto 2000：封端丙氨酸三肽。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在仓库双阱上，把各温度分布与估计量同精确参考比较；报告相邻接受率、往返次数、状态空间均方位移和 MBAR 重叠，并验证续跑与 MPI 结果逐位一致。
methods.gaps_zh: 交换只改善状态混合，不会把 PIMD 采样时间变成动力学，结果保持 converged=false；原文自旋玻璃与多肽模型、温度梯和力场需另行准备。

methods.name: Audited biased-time acceleration and censored rate inference
methods.scope: Postprocessing API integrates interval-resolved exp(beta*(V-V_TS)); censored exponential exposure and optional refitted KS bootstrap. Not a native infrequent-MetaD or OPES-flooding production workflow.
methods.original_system: The OPES-flooding paper uses a 2D double well, gas-phase alanine dipeptide and chignolin folding/unfolding in explicit water. The infrequent-metadynamics paper provides an additional alanine route.
methods.reproduce_observables: First compare unbiased and rescaled first-passage-time distributions, maximum-likelihood rates, censoring fractions and KS diagnostics in a double well. Vary deposition interval, bias barrier and transition-region exclusion.
methods.gaps: Native flooding exclusion is not implemented. The caller must provide bias and transition_bias for every integration interval and evidence that the transition region is unbiased. Sparse FES snapshots cannot supply this clock.
methods.name_zh: 有偏时间加速与删失速率推断
methods.scope_zh: 后处理 API 按积分区间计算 exp[β(V−V_TS)] 时钟，支持删失曝光的指数 MLE 和重新拟合的 KS bootstrap；不是原生 infrequent-MetaD/OPES-flooding 生产工作流。
methods.original_system_zh: OPES-flooding 原论文：二维双阱、气相 alanine dipeptide、显式水 chignolin 折叠/解折叠；infrequent-MetaD 论文可使用其 alanine 路线。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先在双阱比较无偏 first-passage 与重标定时间分布、MLE 速率、删失比例及 KS 诊断；扫描沉积间隔、bias barrier 和 transition exclusion。
methods.gaps_zh: 原生 flooding exclusion 未实现；调用者必须提供每个积分区间的 bias、transition_bias 和无偏 TS 审核。稀疏 FES 保存帧不足以生成该时钟。

methods.name: Two-way canonical transition-interface sampling
methods.scope: Python API; deterministic real-mass ring or P=1 dynamics, variable-length paths with finite cap, fresh uniform shooting point and full canonical momentum redraw. Separate matching effective flux required.
methods.original_system: The original 2003 TIS paper studies isomerization of a diatomic molecule immersed in a simple fluid.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate conditional crossing probabilities, effective positive flux, their product rate, path lengths/acceptance and mechanism mixing across independent path chains. Increase the path cutoff and compare against direct MD or an independently known model.
methods.gaps: The supplied example is a separable double well, not the original fluid model. Automated flux runs, stochastic one-way shooting and complete molecular-rate certification are absent.
methods.name_zh: 双向正则 shooting 的过渡界面采样
methods.scope_zh: Python API 使用确定性实质量环动力学，均匀选择 shooting frame 并重抽全部正则动量；路径有有限长度上限，绝对速率还需独立匹配的有效通量。
methods.original_system_zh: TIS 2003 原论文：简单流体中双原子分子的异构化。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算各界面条件跨越概率、正向有效通量、乘积速率、path length/acceptance、不同路径链的机制混合；增大 path cutoff，验证与直接 MD/已知模型一致。
methods.gaps_zh: 现成例子是可分离双阱，不是原流体模型；没有自动 flux run、随机 one-way shooting 或完整 molecular rate certification。

methods.name: Replica-exchange TIS with optional minus ensemble
methods.scope: Exchanges interface ensembles sharing identical dynamics; repeated/rejected paths remain in observations. minus=true adds [0-] and [0-]<->[0+] exchanges and estimates the effective flux internally from residence times; otherwise a matching external flux is required. Persistent checkpoints and task="path_sampling" are available; asynchronous infinite swaps are the separate samp-infretis entry.
methods.original_system: The original 2007 RETIS paper studies DNA denaturation using the Peyrard–Bishop–Dauxois model.
methods.reproduce_observables: First compare TIS/RETIS conditional probabilities, autocorrelation, walker labels and total cost in the same double well. The original-paper route requires a PBD potential and DNA-denaturation rates and sampling-efficiency comparisons.
methods.gaps: Do not claim complete equivalence to original RETIS for molecular systems: the PBD DNA model is not bundled, and the double-well comparisons with quadrature and full TIS do not certify molecular-rate convergence. MPI orchestration is absent.
methods.name_zh: 可选 minus 系综的交换式 TIS
methods.scope_zh: 交换相同动力学下的界面路径系综并保留拒绝/重复路径。minus=true 增加 [0-] 及 [0-]<->[0+] 交换，并由停留时间在内部估计有效通量；否则需要匹配的外部通量。提供持久 checkpoint 与 task="path_sampling"；异步无限交换见单独条目 samp-infretis。
methods.original_system_zh: RETIS 2007 原论文：Peyrard–Bishop–Dauxois 模型的 DNA 变性。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先在相同双阱比较 TIS/RETIS 的条件概率、自相关、walker labels 和总成本；论文路线需要实现 PBD 势，算 DNA 变性速率与采样效率。
methods.gaps_zh: 不能宣称分子体系上与原始 RETIS 完全等价：未提供 PBD DNA 模型，双阱与积分及完整 TIS 的比较不能证明分子速率收敛；没有 MPI 调度。

methods.name: Partial-path TIS (PPTIS) and REPPTIS
methods.scope: Local three-interface path ensembles with the memory-reduction recurrence for crossing probabilities; REPPTIS adds replica exchange between neighbouring path ensembles. Python API and task="path_sampling" with persistent checkpoints. The memory-loss assumption must be tested against interface spacing and full TIS.
methods.original_system: PPTIS 2004: a simple diatomic system with a diffusive barrier. REPPTIS 2023: ibuprofen permeation through a DPPC membrane.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare REPPTIS rates with full TIS/RETIS and an independent quadrature reference on the same double well; vary interface spacing to test memory loss; report local crossing probabilities, recurrence stability and block errors.
methods.gaps: The membrane-permeation system and its force field are not bundled. A well-sampled local chain alone does not establish memory loss; missing origin populations or a singular recurrence leave the rate unsupported.
methods.name_zh: 部分路径 TIS（PPTIS）与 REPPTIS
methods.scope_zh: 以三界面局部路径系综和记忆约化递推计算跨越概率；REPPTIS 在相邻路径系综间增加副本交换。提供 Python API 与 task="path_sampling"，带持久 checkpoint。记忆丢失假设须用界面间距与完整 TIS 对照检验。
methods.original_system_zh: PPTIS 2004：带扩散势垒的简单双原子体系；REPPTIS 2023：布洛芬穿过 DPPC 膜的渗透。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在同一双阱上把 REPPTIS 速率与完整 TIS/RETIS 及独立积分参考比较；改变界面间距检验记忆丢失；报告局部跨越概率、递推稳定性与分块误差。
methods.gaps_zh: 未提供膜渗透体系及其力场。局部链采样充分本身不能证明记忆丢失；缺少起点布居或递推奇异时不给出速率。

methods.name: Direct forward-flux sampling (FFS)
methods.scope: Interface-by-interface splitting for an explicitly supplied stationary, time-homogeneous Markov step(state, rng) callback: flux from basin-A history, trial-based conditional probabilities, persistent checkpoints and task="path_sampling". Needs no reverse dynamics; the sampler does not choose a thermostat or physical process.
methods.original_system: Allen–Warren–ten Wolde 2005: a symmetric genetic toggle switch of two mutually repressing genes. The 2009 review surveys FFS variants and applications.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare rates and committors with transition-matrix solutions of one- and two-dimensional finite-state Metropolis double wells; report flux, per-interface conditional probabilities, trial counts and zero-success handling over independent seeds.
methods.gaps: The genetic-switch model of the original paper is not bundled. Hidden solver memory, global RNG use and time-dependent protocols violate the callback contract; results apply only to the supplied stochastic process, not to RPMD real-time dynamics.
methods.name_zh: 直接前向通量采样（FFS）
methods.scope_zh: 对显式提供的平稳、时间齐次 Markov 步进回调 step(state, rng) 逐界面分裂：由 A 区历史得到通量、由试验得到条件概率，带持久 checkpoint，也可经 task="path_sampling" 运行。不需要逆向动力学；采样器不替用户选择热浴或物理过程。
methods.original_system_zh: Allen–Warren–ten Wolde 2005：两个相互抑制基因构成的对称遗传开关；2009 年综述总结 FFS 变体与应用。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 与一维、二维有限态 Metropolis 双阱的转移矩阵解比较速率和 committor；报告通量、各界面条件概率、试验数及零成功处理（独立种子）。
methods.gaps_zh: 原文遗传开关模型未提供。隐藏的求解器记忆、全局随机数和含时协议均违反回调约定；结果只适用于所提供的随机过程，不能代替 RPMD 实时间动力学。

methods.name: Asynchronous infinite-swap RETIS (∞RETIS)
methods.scope: exchange="infinite" assigns free paths to free positive ensembles with exact permanent-ratio marginals, computed by a quadratic-cost recurrence for nested interfaces. An asynchronous process executor with ensemble locks and ticket-ordered commits gives exact restart; the minus ensemble is a separate block. Full-Maxwell two-way shooting is kept; the 2024 subtrajectory moves, MPI and bead/GPU worker pools are not implemented.
methods.original_system: Roet–Zhang–van Erp 2022 test ∞RETIS on three model systems. Zhang et al. 2024: the liquid–vapor transition of superheated water, chignolin unfolding and ab initio water dissociation.
methods.reproduce_observables: Check assignment marginals against permutation enumeration on small ladders; compare rates and crossing probabilities with serial RETIS and quadrature on the same double well; report committed events, effective observations, worker-count identity and exact restart.
methods.gaps: Throughput and acceptance claims of the 2024 paper are not reproduced: its subtrajectory moves are absent and commits are ticket-ordered rather than first-finished. The logical worker count is part of the scientific identity and cannot change on resume.
methods.name_zh: 异步无限交换 RETIS（∞RETIS）
methods.scope_zh: exchange="infinite" 以精确的积和式比值边缘概率把空闲路径分配给空闲正界面系综，嵌套界面下用二次复杂度递推计算。异步进程执行器配合系综锁与按票据顺序提交，保证精确续跑；minus 系综单独成块。保留完整 Maxwell 双向 shooting；未实现 2024 年子轨迹移动、MPI 与 bead/GPU 工作池。
methods.original_system_zh: Roet–Zhang–van Erp 2022 在三个模型体系上测试 ∞RETIS；Zhang 等 2024：过热水的液–气相变、chignolin 去折叠和从头算水解离。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在小界面梯上用穷举排列核对分配边缘概率；在同一双阱上把速率与跨越概率同串行 RETIS 和积分参考比较；报告已提交事件数、有效观测数、worker 数身份与精确续跑。
methods.gaps_zh: 未复现 2024 年论文的吞吐与接受率：缺少其子轨迹移动，且按票据顺序而非先完成先提交。逻辑 worker 数属于科学身份，续跑时不能更改。

methods.name: Fixed-full-ring RPMD configurational committor
methods.scope: Independent canonical momentum shots conditioned on every bead position, deterministic unbiased dynamics, A/B first hits plus unresolved shots. Classical committor at P=1; approximate RPMD committor at P>1. Censoring envelope is a project composition of exact binomial limits.
methods.original_system: The primary molecular application by Bolhuis et al. examines alanine dipeptide in vacuum and water and tests whether phi/psi provide an adequate reaction coordinate. It does not introduce this package's ring-polymer extension.
methods.reproduce_observables: First calculate p_B approximately 1/2 at a symmetric double-well barrier configuration and 0/1 at basin boundaries. Vary shots, timestep, horizon and bead count; then calculate P(p_B) on candidate alanine dividing surfaces.
methods.gaps: For P>1, distinguish a fixed full ring from a centroid-conditioned distribution. Collapsing every bead onto the same centroid is not the equilibrium conditional ensemble. Keep unresolved shots; p_B_given_resolved is not the unconditional committor.
methods.name_zh: 固定完整环构型的 RPMD committor
methods.scope_zh: 固定所有 bead 坐标，独立重抽正则动量并传播无偏确定性 first-hit 轨迹。P=1 是经典构型 committor；P>1 是近似 RPMD committor，未决轨迹用精确二项区间构造保守包络。
methods.original_system_zh: Bolhuis 等原始分子应用：真空与水溶液 alanine dipeptide，检验 phi/psi 是否足以描述反应坐标。该论文不提出本包的量子环算法。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先算对称双阱障顶固定构型 p_B≈1/2 和盆地边界 0/1；扫描 shots、dt、horizon、beads；再对 alanine 的候选分界面算 committor 分布 P(p_B)。
methods.gaps_zh: P>1 必须区分固定完整 ring 与质心条件分布；折叠到同一质心的 ring 不是平衡条件 ensemble。未决 shots 不可丢弃；p_B_given_resolved 不是无条件 committor。

methods.name: Aligned RMSD and reference-path collective variables
methods.scope: Weighted proper Kabsch alignment and smooth s/z reference-path variables with explicit scale. Dihedral, coordination and periodic affine CVs are mathematical building blocks; TorchScript supplies derivatives but no learned-CV training method.
methods.original_system: The 2007 path-CV paper studies alanine-dipeptide conformational transitions. Kabsch 1976 is a geometric optimal-rotation algorithm and has no associated chemical dynamics system.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate s/z and full-ring Jacobians, verify rotation/translation invariance, and reconstruct F(s,z) and the path PMF. Test robustness to path-node count and lambda.
methods.gaps: Prepare the original reference path and molecular potential separately. Implementing CVs for a supplied path is not the complete global path-optimization protocol of the original paper.
methods.name_zh: 对齐 RMSD 与参考路径 CV
methods.scope_zh: 加权 proper Kabsch 对齐、显式尺度的平滑 s/z 路径变量。二面角、配位数和周期仿射 CV 是数学构件；TorchScript 仅提供用户模型值/导数，不包含学习 CV 的训练方法。
methods.original_system_zh: Path-CV 2007 原论文：alanine dipeptide 构象变化；Kabsch 1976 是几何最优旋转算法，没有对应动力学化学体系。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 s/z 及全 ring Jacobian、旋转平移不变性、F(s,z) 和沿路径 PMF；检查路径节点数和 lambda 稳健性。
methods.gaps_zh: 需另配原文参考路径与分子势；只实现给定 path 的 CV 不等于完成原论文全局路径优化协议。

methods.name: Learned centroid CVs from mlcolvar (Deep-LDA / Deep-TICA) via TorchScript
