methods.scope: Training happens in the external mlcolvar library; PyRPMD evaluates the exported CPU float64 TorchScript graph (preprocessing, network and projection) with TorchScriptCV, including Cartesian derivatives and ring-bead scaling. Optional dependencies; deployment checks do not establish CV quality.
methods.original_system: Deep-LDA 2020: alanine dipeptide and an intermolecular aldol reaction. Deep-TICA 2021: a small-molecule conformational transition, miniprotein folding and materials crystallization. The 2023 mlcolvar paper describes the library framework.
methods.reproduce_observables: First verify TorchScript values and Cartesian gradients against finite differences and the training-time model; then compare biased FES, transition counts and CV separability on a model with a known slow coordinate, with independent training seeds and data splits.
methods.gaps: The original molecular systems require their descriptors, training data and enhanced-sampling protocols. A learned CV is only as good as its training data; check transferability and that the exported graph matches the trained model version.
methods.name_zh: mlcolvar 学习的质心 CV（Deep-LDA / Deep-TICA，TorchScript 部署）
methods.scope_zh: 训练在外部 mlcolvar 库中完成；PyRPMD 用 TorchScriptCV 求值导出的 CPU float64 TorchScript 图（预处理、网络与投影），包括笛卡尔导数和环珠缩放。依赖可选；部署检查不能证明 CV 质量。
methods.original_system_zh: Deep-LDA 2020：丙氨酸二肽与分子间羟醛反应；Deep-TICA 2021：小分子构象转变、微型蛋白折叠与材料结晶；mlcolvar 2023 论文介绍库框架。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先用有限差分和训练时模型核对 TorchScript 值与笛卡尔梯度；再在已知慢坐标的模型上比较偏置 FES、跃迁次数与 CV 区分度，使用独立训练种子与数据划分。
methods.gaps_zh: 原文分子体系需要其描述符、训练数据与增强采样协议；学到的 CV 受训练数据限制，需检查可迁移性并确认导出图与训练模型版本一致。

methods.name: Euclidean mean-force / restrained adaptive strings
methods.scope: Fixed-endpoint Euclidean gradient relaxation and insertion; a supplied consistent free-energy gradient is required. Signed restrained extension uses scaled Euclidean geometry; general nonlinear-CV metric/conditional terms of a full MFEP are not all implemented.
methods.original_system: The 2002 string paper includes Lennard-Jones cluster rearrangements and magnetic-film switching. The 2006 CV-string paper studies alanine dipeptide using two versus four dihedral angles.
methods.reproduce_observables: First verify normal-force residuals, node count and reparameterization on an analytic curved valley. For the 2006 route, calculate the MFEP, free-energy barrier and committor width as CV choice changes.
methods.gaps: A PES gradient yields an MEP only. The package should not be described as a complete arbitrary-nonlinear-CV MFEP or isocommittor construction. The original four-angle route requires the missing metric terms.
methods.name_zh: 欧氏平均力与约束自适应 string
methods.scope_zh: 固定端点的梯度松弛、重参数化和插点；需要调用者提供一致的自由能梯度。约束扩展仍用缩放欧氏几何，没有完整一般非线性 CV 的 MFEP 度量和条件项。
methods.original_system_zh: 2002 string 原论文：Lennard–Jones cluster 重排和磁性薄膜翻转；2006 CV string：alanine dipeptide，比较 2 与 4 个二面角。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先在解析弯曲谷检验法向力残差、节点数与重参数化；论文 2006 路线算 MFEP、自由能势垒及 committor 宽度随 CV 选择变化。
methods.gaps_zh: 用 PES 梯度只得到 MEP；本包不应直接声称实现任意 nonlinear CV 的完整 MFEP/等 committor 面。原论文 4-angle route 需补齐 metric 项。

methods.name: Finite-temperature string in centroid CV space
methods.scope: Restrained centroid sampling with the averaged CV mass metric, block diagnostics, fixed-endpoint path updates and exact iteration-boundary replay, reusing the existing arc-length reparameterization. Fixed image count and endpoints; nonperiodic centroid CVs with full-rank derivatives. At finite restraint stiffness it targets a smoothed free-energy path.
methods.original_system: E–Ren–Vanden-Eijnden 2005 validate the finite-temperature string on a two-dimensional example and a model solid–solid transformation. Maragliano et al. 2006 formulate the string in collective variables with the CV metric tensor.
methods.reproduce_observables: On an analytic 2D surface, compare the converged string with the minimum free-energy path from quadrature; report image spacing, metric-tensor estimates, restraint-stiffness and sampling-length dependence, and path stability over independent seeds.
methods.gaps: Endpoints and image count are fixed; periodic CVs and rank-deficient CV derivatives are rejected. A smoothed path at finite stiffness is not yet a converged minimum free-energy path, and the solid–solid model of the 2005 paper is not bundled.
methods.name_zh: 质心 CV 空间中的有限温度弦方法
methods.scope_zh: 在质心 CV 上做约束采样，使用平均 CV 质量度规、块诊断、固定端点的路径更新与精确的迭代边界重放，并复用已有弧长重参数化。像数和端点固定；限非周期、导数满秩的质心 CV。有限约束刚度下得到的是平滑化自由能路径。
methods.original_system_zh: E–Ren–Vanden-Eijnden 2005 在二维例子和固–固相变模型上验证有限温度弦方法；Maragliano 等 2006 用 CV 度规张量在集体变量空间中表述弦方法。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在解析二维势面上，把收敛弦与积分得到的最小自由能路径比较；报告像间距、度规张量估计、约束刚度与采样长度依赖性，以及独立种子下的路径稳定性。
methods.gaps_zh: 端点和像数固定；不支持周期 CV 和秩亏 CV 导数。有限刚度下的平滑路径还不是收敛的最小自由能路径；未提供 2005 年论文的固–固相变模型。

methods.name: Partitioned rational-function saddle optimization
methods.scope: Fresh finite-difference Hessians, separate uphill/downhill augmented eigenproblems and capped trial steps. Local molecular Cartesian saddle search; two-sided descent is a connectivity diagnostic, not a certified quantum-chemistry IRC.
methods.original_system: The 1985 paper uses two analytic model surfaces, including the Cerjan–Miller model; its Fig.3 shows the minimum and saddles at ±(1,0).
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate saddle positions/energies, Hessian negative-mode counts, gradient residuals and sensitivity to initial guesses. Vary Hessian finite-difference spacing, then calculate the electronic barrier and imaginary frequency for H+H2/BKMP2.
methods.gaps: Match the original analytic model definitions and energy scaling. Optimization iteration counts depend on this implementation's control rules and need not reproduce the original counts.
methods.name_zh: 分区有理函数鞍点优化
methods.scope_zh: 每次生成有限差分 Hessian，分别求上坡/下坡增广本征问题并限制步长；两侧下降仅作连通性诊断，不是经过认证的量子化学 IRC。
methods.original_system_zh: 1985 原论文的两个解析模型势面，包括 Cerjan–Miller 模型；论文 Fig.3 示 minimum 与 ±(1,0) saddles。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 saddle 坐标/能量、Hessian 负模数、梯度残差和初猜敏感性；扫描 Hessian 差分步长，再在 H+H2/BKMP2 算电子势垒和虚频。
methods.gaps_zh: 需保持论文解析模型定义与本包能量缩放一致；优化迭代数受本实现控制策略影响，不可假设与原文完全相同。

methods.name: CI-NEB with improved tangent and FIRE relaxation
methods.scope: Energy-weighted tangent, climbing image and FIRE optimizer. Current end-to-end rate preparation is molecular Cartesian/nonperiodic, so the original slab calculations are not directly covered by that workflow.
methods.original_system: The original CI-NEB paper studies CH4 dissociative adsorption on Ir(111) and H2 on Si(100). The improved-tangent paper additionally includes Si exchange diffusion and an Al addimer on Al(100).
methods.reproduce_observables: First verify the Müller–Brown MEP, barrier, highest-image true force, NEB force and convergence with image count/initial path; then use BKMP2. Reproducing the original slabs requires a separate DFT/ASE route.
methods.gaps: The original slab Hamiltonians/DFT and periodic fixed-layer setup are outside the current gas-phase prepare workflow. Original-system reproduction needs additional implementation; H3 is not a substitute for those original systems.
methods.name_zh: CI-NEB、改进切向与 FIRE 松弛
methods.scope_zh: 实现能量加权切向、攀爬像和 FIRE；当前端到端 rate preparation 面向非周期分子笛卡尔体系，不能直接承担原论文表面 slab 计算。
methods.original_system_zh: CI-NEB 原论文：CH4 在 Ir(111) 的解离吸附及 H2/Si(100)；改进 tangent 论文还包括 Si 交换扩散和 Al(100) addimer。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 方法回归先算 Müller–Brown MEP、barrier、最高 image 真力、NEB force 与 image 数/初始路径收敛，再做 BKMP2；原 slab 体系需外部独立 DFT/ASE 路线。
methods.gaps_zh: 论文 slab force field/DFT 与周期固定层限制不在当前 gas-phase prepare 支持范围；应明确原体系复现需要额外实现，不用 H3 冒充。

methods.name: Covalent-radius connectivity and channel inference
methods.scope: Cordero H–Cm tabulated radii plus package bond_scale=1.25 heuristic and user overrides. This is approximate graph classification, not an electronic bond-order model.
methods.original_system: The original parameter paper derives covalent radii from crystal-structure statistics for most elements through atomic number 96. It is a data source, not one molecular-dynamics test system.
methods.reproduce_observables: Check radii, units and isotope handling against the original table. Validate inferred connectivity and threshold sensitivity on known reactant/product geometries.
methods.gaps: The threshold, two-sided descents and equivalent-channel combination are package choices. The Cordero data paper does not establish correct reaction identification for arbitrary structures.
methods.name_zh: 共价半径连通图与反应通道推断
methods.scope_zh: 采用 Cordero 的 H–Cm 半径表，加本包 bond_scale=1.25 阈值和用户覆盖；这是近似图分类，不是电子键级模型。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文参数来自晶体结构统计，覆盖大部分原子序数至 96 的元素；不是需要跑 MD 的单一体系。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 核对所有 radii/units/isotopes 与原表；在已知 reactant/product 几何上验证图连通性和阈值敏感性。
methods.gaps_zh: 分类阈值与两侧下降/等价通道组合属于包实现，不能由 Cordero 参数论文证明任意反应识别正确。

methods.name: General nonlinear-coordinate constrained-parent mass metric
methods.scope: Constrained-to-conditional weighting for nonlinear centroid coordinates; reparametrization invariance tests. The package rate estimator is an RPMD combination, not identical reproduction of every blue-moon thermodynamic-integration variant.
methods.original_system: The original papers derive ensemble relations for general constrained reaction coordinates. The complete 1998 chemical application protocol has not been recovered, so no unverified molecule is assigned.
methods.reproduce_observables: First test rate invariance under s, a*s and nonlinear monotonic f(s) on the same analytic potential; check mass metrics and constrained-parent weights. Then test a general bond-difference coordinate.
methods.gaps: The nonlinear-CV mass metric cannot be omitted. Agreement of projected PMFs does not guarantee agreement of unbiased dynamical rates.
methods.name_zh: 一般非线性质心坐标的约束质量度量
methods.scope_zh: 将受约束父样本转换为条件系综权重，并检验坐标重参数化不变性；属于 RPMD 速率理论组合，不等于实现全部 blue-moon 热力学积分变体。
methods.original_system_zh: 原论文为一般受约束反应坐标的 ensemble 关系；本次未恢复完整 1998 化学应用协议，不指定未经核实的分子。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 优先对同一解析势使用 s、a*s、非线性单调 f(s) 比较速率不变性，检查 mass metric 与 constrained-parent weights；再测一般键差坐标。
methods.gaps_zh: 非线性 CV 的质量度量不能省略；相同投影 PMF 不保证相同无偏动力学速率。

methods.name: 2D flux integration and signed multichannel postprocessing
methods.scope: Project extension of flux-over-population / Bennett–Chandler RPMD rate theory; no standalone original paper for this exact offline data pipeline. CV-density and rate-flux measures require different factors.
methods.original_system: The existing physical regression uses the two atom-labelled exchange exits of H+H2/BKMP2. It is not the original system of a separate new-method paper.
methods.reproduce_observables: Calculate consistency of 1D/2D static flux from the same samples, kappa_i(t), channel rates and branching fractions using a shared-parent-chain bootstrap. Check complete dividing-surface support and entrance normalization.
methods.gaps: Product-basin Boltzmann weights are not dynamical branching fractions. Overlapping transition-surface fluxes cannot be added unconditionally, and exit labels do not supply an extra factor of two.
methods.name_zh: 二维通量与带符号多通道后处理
methods.scope_zh: 基于 flux-over-population / Bennett–Chandler RPMD 的项目扩展；需要同时引用核心速率论文。FES 概率密度测度与速率通量测度具有不同因子，没有独立离线管线原创论文。
methods.original_system_zh: 项目现有物理回归：H+H2/BKMP2 的两个带原子标签交换出口；不是独立新方法原始论文体系。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算同样本一维/二维静态通量一致性、kappa_i(t)、k_i 与 branching_i 的共同父链 bootstrap；检查完整分界面支持和入口归一化。
methods.gaps_zh: 不能把产物盆地 Boltzmann 权重当动力学分支；不能无条件相加重叠 TS 通量；出口标签不提供额外倍数二。

methods.name: Correlation diagnostics and synchronized circular-block bootstrap
methods.scope: Circular block resampling is Politis–Romano; positive-pair correlation truncation is a related diagnostic. PyRPMD chooses CV/squared-CV/circular-harmonic probes, ceil(5g) blocks with N/2 cap, and joint windows/channels for correlated ensembles. These safeguards are project policies, not universal published constants.
methods.original_system: The statistical papers do not specify a PyRPMD chemical system. AR(1) data with known covariance and analytic harmonic time series provide independent calibration cases.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare standard-error coverage, block-length sensitivity and independent-seed variance. Preserve a common resampling clock across REUS windows and a common parent chain across product channels.
methods.gaps: Reporting g/ESS does not establish mixing. Do not present 5g, 20 blocks or a fixed overlap threshold as universal guarantees from the cited papers.
methods.name_zh: 相关诊断与同步循环块 bootstrap
methods.scope_zh: 循环块重采样依照 Politis–Romano；正相邻对截断仅是相关诊断。CV/平方/周期谐波探针、ceil(5g) 和 N/2 上限是项目规则，交换窗口与出口通道保持共同重采样时钟。
methods.original_system_zh: 统计原论文不规定本包化学体系；可用已知协方差的 AR(1) 和解析 harmonic 时间序列作独立校准。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 比较标准误覆盖率、block 长度敏感性、独立种子方差；REUS 保持跨窗口同一个 resampling clock，channels 保持共同父链。
methods.gaps_zh: 报告 g/ESS 不是已证实混合；不能把 5g、20 blocks 或固定 overlap threshold 写成论文保证。

methods.name: PLUMED centroid-bias bridge
methods.scope: External kernel/interface, not an internal implementation of every PLUMED method. Cite the PLUMED software and every selected CV/bias algorithm in the actual plumed.dat.
methods.original_system: The original software papers contain several examples. Validate the bridge with a specifically defined algorithm and model; the software name is not itself a physical method.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare CVs, bias, forces and one-step trajectories between this package and external PLUMED on the same model, then reproduce the original system of the chosen sampling algorithm.
methods.existing_entry: python examples/plumed/centroid_metadynamics.py --steps 200 --output runs/plumed-centroid; python benchmarks/tier2_literature/sampling.py plumed --output runs/tier2-sampling
methods.gaps: External-history management and automated resume have explicit limitations. An unconfigured PLUMED action is not an implemented PyRPMD feature.
methods.name_zh: PLUMED 质心偏置接口
methods.scope_zh: 连接外部 PLUMED kernel，不能视为内部实现全部 PLUMED action；实际使用时同时引用软件及 plumed.dat 选择的每个 CV/偏置算法。
methods.original_system_zh: 原始软件论文包含多个示例；桥接验证应选择已确定算法/模型，不把软件名作为独立物理方法。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 同一模型比较本包与外部 PLUMED 的 CV、bias、forces 和单步轨迹；再按所选算法的原论文体系复现。
methods.gaps_zh: 外部历史管理和自动 resume 有明确限制；尚未配置的 PLUMED action 不算 PyRPMD 已实现功能。

methods.name: Focused nonequilibrium MMST NRPMD
methods.scope: One mapping vector per nuclear bead, any finite number of electronic states and real/complex Hermitian fixed-diabatic matrices. Focused radii sqrt(3) for the initially occupied state and 1 otherwise, random angles, signed unclipped MMST populations. This is not a Gamma/SEO thermal initial state, PLDM, SQC, or the independent mapping-bead multiplicity generalized in the 2017 analysis.
methods.original_system: 2019 paper: one-dimensional three-state Morse photodissociation models, plus one-mode two-state spin-boson models. The 2013 equilibrium coupled-harmonic model belongs to the separate signed-thermal row.
reproduce_observables: Electronic populations P_i(t), matching the paper's vertically excited nuclear distribution and focused MMST estimator
Three-state Morse dissociation branches and long-time populations; coherent oscillations in the one-mode spin-boson model
Converge timestep, bead count and independent nuclear trajectories separately; retain signed estimators and statistical errors
methods.existing_entry: pyrpmd run examples/nonadiabatic/population.inp --output runs/nrpmd; PYTHONPATH=src python benchmarks/nonadiabatic/population_dynamics.py --smoke --output population_smoke.json
methods.gaps: The two existing entries are teaching/synthetic-LVC regressions, not the 2019 parameter sets. Implement the three-state Morse parameters from Table I or the corresponding one-mode model with its initial distribution. Check the offdiagonal matrix-element convention: a paper parameter Delta/2 is not the same input as DiscreteSpinBoson.tunnelling=Delta.
methods.name_zh: Focused 非平衡 MMST-NRPMD
methods.scope_zh: 每个核 bead 配一组 MMST 变量，支持多电子态实/复 Hermitian 矩阵。采用 focused 初始电子态和有符号、未裁剪的布居估计量；不包括 PLDM、SQC，也不等同于 SEO 热平衡采样。
methods.original_system_zh: Chowdhury–Huo 2019：一维三态 Morse 光解离模型，以及单模两态 spin-boson 模型。2013 论文的热平衡耦合谐振子另列在 signed thermal NRPMD。
reproduce_observables_zh: 各电子态布居 P_i(t)，匹配原文的垂直激发初始核分布与 focused MMST 估计量
三态 Morse 解离分支与长时间布居；一模 spin-boson 相干振荡
分别收敛时间步、beads、独立核轨迹数；保留带符号估计量与统计误差
methods.gaps_zh: 这两个现成入口是教学/合成 LVC 回归，不是 2019 原文参数集。需要录入原文 Table I 的三态 Morse 模型或对应一模模型及初始分布。注意论文中 Δ/2 与包 DiscreteSpinBoson.tunnelling=Δ 的矩阵元约定，不能直接复制同名参数。

methods.name: MInt mapping subflow integrator
methods.scope: Exact electronic rotation at fixed nuclear geometry with the integrated nuclear momentum impulse, composed with the free-ring subflow. This cites an integrator component, not the complete MQC-IVR calculation in Church et al.
methods.original_system: The cited paper develops a mixed quantum-classical IVR; package reuse is at the level of the MInt Hamiltonian subflow.
reproduce_observables: Exact constant-matrix electronic rotation and nuclear momentum impulse at fixed geometry
Time reversal and timestep convergence with noncommuting matrix gradients; energy drift diagnoses integration, not the physical accuracy of approximate dynamics
methods.existing_entry: NRPMDDynamics / SMNRPMDDynamics Python APIs; the normal NRPMD examples exercise this integrator.
methods.gaps: Do not list the full MQC-IVR results as reproducible: the package does not supply that algorithm's IVR phases, amplitudes and prefactors.
methods.name_zh: MInt 电子映射积分子步
methods.scope_zh: 固定核位置时精确传播电子映射旋转及其核动量冲量，再与自由环聚合子步对称组合。引用的是 Church 等人论文中的积分组成部分，包未实现该文完整 MQC-IVR。
methods.original_system_zh: Church 等人 2018 提出混合量子/经典 IVR；此处适合复现积分子步的数学性质，不能把完整 IVR 数值结果列为已支持功能。
reproduce_observables_zh: 固定核坐标下常矩阵解析电子旋转与动量冲量
非对易矩阵梯度条件下时间反演和步长收敛；总能漂移是数值诊断，不是近似动力学精确性的证据
methods.gaps_zh: 无需把 MQC-IVR 的全部结果列为可复现；包没有对应 IVR 相位、振幅和前因子流程。

methods.name: Signed SEO thermal NRPMD and correlation/rate estimators
methods.scope: Real symmetric matrices only; sample the absolute SEO-projected initial weight and retain its initial sign in every correlation. Thermal weight is not exp(-beta/P * NRPMD energy). Library default scalar/traceless splitting differs from the 2013 paper's lowest-adiabatic-surface split; the dedicated published benchmark implements that split explicitly. Single-state scalar dynamics reduces to ordinary RPMD. Finite-time rate output is not automatically a converged formal rate.
methods.original_system: Richardson–Thoss 2013 Fig. 1(c), Eq. 15: H=p²/2+x²/2+[[x,1],[1,-x]], with m=hbar=omega=kappa=beta=Delta=1 and alpha=0, as explicitly transcribed in the repository's paper benchmark.
reproduce_observables: Kubo position autocorrelation C_xx(t)
Electronic correlation with an initial SEO projector and final MMST population
Average sign, effective independent samples/between-chain uncertainty, bead and timestep convergence, and an independent sinc-DVR comparison
For a rate calculation, additionally verify reactant normalization, a correlation plateau and the plateau fitting interval
methods.gaps: The existing Fig. 1(c) entry is the most direct paper-reproduction starting point, but still needs independent convergence studies. Curves from the default trace split must be labeled as a different splitting approximation. The short thermal_rate.inp run cannot establish a physically converged rate; complex-matrix phase reweighting is not implemented.
methods.name_zh: 带符号 SEO 热平衡 NRPMD 与相关/速率估计量
methods.scope_zh: 仅实对称矩阵：对 SEO 初始权重的绝对值采样，相关函数保留初始 sign。默认 scalar/traceless 分裂不同于 2013 论文的最低绝热面分裂；专用 published benchmark 明确实现后者。热分布不是普通 exp(-βH/P)。
methods.original_system_zh: Richardson–Thoss 2013 图 1(c)：H=p²/2+x²/2+[[x,1],[1,-x]]，m=ℏ=ω=κ=β=Δ=1、α=0；仓库专用脚本明确转录了该模型。
reproduce_observables_zh: Kubo 位置自相关 C_xx(t)
初始 SEO 电子投影与末态 MMST 布居构成的电子相关函数
平均 sign、有效独立样本/链间误差、bead 与时间步收敛，和独立 sinc-DVR 结果比较
若目标是速率，另外验证反应物归一化、相关函数平台和平台拟合区间
methods.gaps_zh: 现有 Fig. 1(c) 入口是最直接的原文复现起点，仍须执行独立收敛研究。用默认 trace split 得到的曲线应标为不同分裂下的比较。thermal_rate.inp 的短时结果不能声称得到物理收敛速率；复杂矩阵的相位重加权未实现。

methods.name: Adaptive restrained-path signed NRPMD composition
methods.scope: Package composition of signed SEO thermal sampling, restrained-path adaptation, free-energy reweighting, and independent production with the path frozen. There is no verified single original paper presenting the complete PyRPMD adaptive/electrode workflow.
methods.original_system: NRPMD's original coupled-harmonic equilibrium model is a component check. The package's confined two-state and electrode examples are new composite validation systems, not systems from a single original adaptive-NRPMD paper.
reproduce_observables: First reproduce the 2013 NRPMD thermal correlation, then verify restrained free energies for a known reaction coordinate
After freezing the path, use independent production samples for free-energy differences/flux correlations; report signs, window overlap and statistical uncertainty
Check that fixed-path and adaptive-path results agree within their uncertainties
methods.gaps: Cite each component separately; do not invent a single origin paper for the composite workflow or claim a validated electrochemical rate from a short adaptation trajectory.
methods.name_zh: 自适应约束路径与带符号 NRPMD 组合工作流
methods.scope_zh: 组合 SEO 热采样、约束路径适应、自由能重加权及冻结路径后的独立生产采样。未核实存在一篇同时提出 PyRPMD 完整组合的原始论文；应分别引用 NRPMD、有限温度 string 和 MBAR。
methods.original_system_zh: 2013 耦合谐振子是 NRPMD 组成部分的原文基准；包内 confined 两态及 electrode 例子是组合验证体系，不能称为同一篇自适应 NRPMD 论文的体系。
reproduce_observables_zh: 先复现 NRPMD2013 热平衡相关函数，再验证已知反应坐标下的约束自由能
冻结路径后用独立生产样本计算自由能差/通量相关函数；报告 sign、窗口重叠与统计误差
比较固定路径和自适应路径是否在不确定度内给出一致结果
methods.gaps_zh: 需要对每个组成部分分别引用；不能给组合工作流编造一篇原始论文，也不能用一条短适应轨迹宣称新的电化学速率已验证。

methods.name: Focused two-state SM-NRPMD
methods.scope: One two-state W-spin of radius sqrt(3)/2 per bead, focused u_z=±1/sqrt(3) with random azimuth, real or complex Hermitian matrices, and exact spin/impulse subflows. No general SU(N) implementation and no Gamma_W equilibrium trace/phase sampler.
methods.original_system: 2021 paper includes a low-temperature one-dimensional two-state model and seven harmonic spin-boson cases. For cases I–VII, H=p²/2+R²/2+[[R+epsilon,Delta],[Delta,-R-epsilon]], m=hbar=omega=beta=1; (Delta,epsilon)=(10,0),(4,0),(1,2),(1,0.5),(1,0),(0.1,1.5),(0.1,0).
reproduce_observables: Electronic populations under focused initialization and conservation of spin length
For the paper's equilibrium C_RR(t) and C_nn(t), use its Gamma_W initial density, weights and estimators together
methods.gaps: The existing example verifies focused propagation. Current initialization cannot directly reproduce the main equilibrium-correlation figures: add Gamma_W sampling and the matching estimators before claiming quantitative reproduction of those results.
methods.availability: CLI for focused dynamics; equilibrium reproduction incomplete
methods.name_zh: Focused 两态自旋映射 NRPMD
methods.scope_zh: 每个 bead 一个 W-spin，半径 √3/2，focused u_z=±1/√3；支持两态实/复 Hermitian 矩阵。当前未实现通用 SU(N)，也未实现原文 Γ_W 平衡 trace/phase 采样。
reproduce_observables_zh: focused 初始条件下的电子布居与自旋长度守恒
原文热平衡 C_RR(t) 与 C_nn(t) 必须同时使用原文 Gamma_W 初始分布、权重与估计量
methods.gaps_zh: 现成例子只能验证 focused 动力学。原文主要平衡相关函数图不能由当前初始化直接复现；先补 Gamma_W 采样及对应估计量再列为原文定量复现。

methods.name: Classical-nuclei MASH and experimental centroid extension
methods.scope: MASHDynamics implements real two-state spin-hemisphere deterministic hopping through the adiabatic interface. P=1 is the original classical-nuclei setting. Its P>1 centroid extension is explicitly experimental and distinct from RPMASHDynamics. Hops are located at step endpoints; the documented hop-position error requires time-step convergence.
methods.original_system: Original MASH: Tully scattering, spin-boson and pyrazine models. The 2024 rate follow-up uses an electron-transfer spin-boson model represented by a Brownian-oscillator reaction coordinate and an Ohmic bath.
reproduce_observables: State-resolved Tully I-III reflection/transmission probabilities versus incident momentum at P=1
Electronic populations and coherences using the required MASH |S_z| population sampling and observable weights
Extend to electron-transfer rates in the reaction-coordinate spin-boson model, compared with Marcus/exact references
methods.gaps: The existing entry is a two-state interface demonstration. Add the paper's scattering/ET parameters and ensemble analysis; a generic LVC class does not provide the published multimode pyrazine parameters. Do not label the experimental P>1 MASHDynamics as CA-RP-MASH or claim implementation of a later reversible event integrator.
methods.availability: Python API/demo, not the rp-mash CLI alias
methods.name_zh: 经典核 MASH 与实验性质心扩展
methods.scope_zh: MASHDynamics 通过自旋半球确定活动态。P=1 对应原始两态 MASH；P>1 是实验性质心扩展，与独立的 CA-RP-MASH 类不同。跳跃定位在步末，因此需要时间步收敛。
methods.original_system_zh: Mannouch–Richardson 2023：Tully 散射、spin-boson 和 pyrazine 模型。2024 速率后续论文使用 Brownian-oscillator 反应坐标加 Ohmic 浴的电子转移模型。
reproduce_observables_zh: P=1 下 Tully I–III 的分态反射/透射几率随入射动量的变化
电子布居与相干；严格匹配 MASH 的 |S_z| 布居采样和相应权重
扩展到反应坐标 spin-boson 的电子转移速率与 Marcus/精确参考比较
methods.gaps_zh: 该入口是两态接口演示。需补原文散射/ET 参数和轨迹统计驱动；原文的多模 pyrazine 参数未随通用 LVC 类自动提供。不能把实验性 P>1 MASHDynamics 标为 CA-RP-MASH，亦不能声称实现了后续可逆事件积分器。

methods.name: CA-RP-MASH (CLI method rp-mash)
methods.scope: One spin and one common active adiabatic surface for the whole ring; bead-local adiabatic nuclear forces and centroid electronic dynamics. Real symmetric two-state matrices with nonzero gaps. SciPy DOP853 event-root handling resolves spin equator crossings, with full-ring mass-metric hop energy rescaling. BA-RP-MASH and multistate MASH are separate entries (na-ba-rp-mash, na-ms-mash); complex-SOC MASH is absent. General correlations use operator-pair weights; population output is an active-surface indicator, not a generic spin-density population.
methods.original_system: Cao–Suarez–Kretchmer 2025 v1: Tully models, a three-mode pyrazine model, and spin-boson electron transfer. The published source being followed is explicitly the preprint version cited above.
reproduce_observables: State-resolved Tully transmission/reflection and population time series, starting with the P=1 limit
Spin-boson electron-transfer rates and nuclear quantum effects with the paper's preparation and bath discretization
Correct operator-pair weights W_CC=3, W_CP=2, W_PP=2|S_z(0)|, together with event-tolerance/max_step convergence
methods.gaps: The existing input is a teaching model. Add the published pyrazine/bath parameters, independent equilibrium or scattering preparation, and rate analysis. Arbitrary harmonic-ring population curves are not a reproduction of the paper's thermal rates. The current implementation uses native=False.
methods.name_zh: CA-RP-MASH（命令行 rp-mash）
methods.scope_zh: 整条环共用一个自旋和活动面，核力在各 bead 求值、电子动力学在质心求值；限两态实对称、非零能隙。DOP853 事件求根定位过赤道跳跃并按全环能量重标动量；BA-RP-MASH 与多态 MASH 见单独条目（na-ba-rp-mash、na-ms-mash），不含复 SOC。
methods.original_system_zh: Cao–Suarez–Kretchmer 2025 v1 预印本：Tully 模型、三模 pyrazine、spin-boson 电子转移。引用实际实现所依据的 v1；截至本次检索未核实期刊后继版本。
reproduce_observables_zh: Tully 分态透射/反射以及布居时间序列，先比较 P=1 极限
按原文预备与浴离散化计算 spin-boson 电子转移速率及核量子效应
使用正确算符对权重：W_CC=3、W_CP=2、W_PP=2|S_z(0)|，并验证 event tolerance/max_step 收敛
methods.gaps_zh: 现成输入是教学模型。需要原文参数化 pyrazine/bath、独立平衡或散射预备与速率分析；严禁把任意 harmonic-ring 初态布居曲线视作原文热速率复现。native=False 路径为当前实现。

methods.name: BA-RP-MASH (CLI method rp-mash-ba)
methods.scope: Two-state bead approximation: one spin for the whole ring in a common adiabatic representation, beadwise matrices, gradients, gaps and derivative couplings, and bead-averaged electronic evolution. Separate state, workflow name and scientific identity from CA-RP-MASH (rp-mash); not multistate or complex-SOC MASH.
methods.original_system: Cao–Suarez–Kretchmer 2025 v1 preprint: Tully models, a three-mode pyrazine model and spin-boson electron transfer; the bead approximation is defined in the same preprint.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare populations with an independent Fourier-grid reference in the constant-gap, constant-coupling limit; then reproduce the preprint's Tully and spin-boson observables with its preparation; converge timestep, event tolerance and bead count.
methods.gaps: The Fourier comparison makes internal ring modes spectators and uses scalar nuclear Wigner sampling; it does not establish general nuclear quantum accuracy. Record the implemented preprint version explicitly.
methods.name_zh: BA-RP-MASH（命令行 rp-mash-ba）
methods.scope_zh: 两态珠近似：整条环共用一个自旋并采用共同绝热表象，各珠分别计算矩阵、梯度、能隙与导数耦合，电子演化取珠平均。状态、工作流名称和科学身份均与 CA-RP-MASH（rp-mash）分开；不是多态或复 SOC MASH。
methods.original_system_zh: Cao–Suarez–Kretchmer 2025 v1 预印本：Tully 模型、三模 pyrazine 模型与 spin-boson 电子转移；珠近似在同一预印本中定义。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先在常能隙、常耦合极限下与独立 Fourier 网格参考比较布居；再按预印本的初态准备复现 Tully 与 spin-boson 观测量；收敛时间步、事件容差和珠数。
methods.gaps_zh: Fourier 对照中环内模只是旁观者，并使用标量核 Wigner 采样，不能证明一般的核量子精度；须明确记录所实现的预印本版本。

methods.name: Original multistate MASH (CLI method multistate-mash)
methods.scope: One normalized complex mapping vector, active adiabatic surface with the largest mapping population, and the Runeson–Manolopoulos signed observable estimator for real Hamiltonians with nondegenerate levels; one bead only. The original 2023 formulation, not unSMASH or later initialization variants, and distinct from the two-state estimator even for two states.
methods.original_system: Runeson–Manolopoulos 2023: three- and seven-state models of the Fenna–Matthews–Olson complex.
methods.reproduce_observables: Populations and coherences of the FMO models against exact benchmarks with the paper's bath discretization and initial conditions; long-time equilibrium populations; timestep and trajectory-count convergence.
methods.gaps: The FMO Hamiltonians and spectral densities of the paper are not bundled; ring-polymer multistate MASH is not implemented.
methods.name_zh: 原始多态 MASH（命令行 multistate-mash）
methods.scope_zh: 一个归一化复映射矢量，活动绝热面取映射布居最大的态，使用 Runeson–Manolopoulos 带符号观测量估计；限实哈密顿量、非简并能级、单珠。实现的是 2023 年原始表述，不是 unSMASH 或后续初始化变体；即使两态也不同于两态 MASH 估计量。
methods.original_system_zh: Runeson–Manolopoulos 2023：Fenna–Matthews–Olson 复合物的三态与七态模型。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 按原文浴离散化与初始条件计算 FMO 模型的布居与相干，并与精确基准比较；长时间平衡布居；时间步与轨迹数收敛。
methods.gaps_zh: 未提供原文 FMO 哈密顿量与谱密度；未实现环聚合物多态 MASH。

methods.name: FSSH / centroid-approximation RPSH
methods.scope: RPSHDynamics is the real fixed-diabatic centroid route; AdvancedRPSHDynamics(method='ca') exposes extended CA options; direct AdiabaticRPSHDynamics accepts electronic-structure data. Each ring has a common active surface. P=1 is the classical-nuclei FSSH limit. Rescaling, frustrated-hop policy and initial distribution are explicit conventions and must match the target paper.
methods.original_system: Tully1990: three one-dimensional two-state scattering models. Shushkov–Li–Tully2012: two-state scattering with thermal total/state-selected rates. Shakib–Huo2017: Tully low-momentum reflection/transmission, with further models in the supporting information.
reproduce_observables: Four final-channel reflection/transmission probabilities versus p0
Save active-surface fractions, amplitude populations and electronic coherences separately; none is a substitute for the others
To reproduce the 2012 thermal rates, include incident-flux normalization and thermal averaging instead of calling a final-state fraction a rate
methods.existing_entry: pyrpmd run examples/nonadiabatic/rpsh_population.inp --output runs/rpsh; python examples/nonadiabatic/adiabatic_on_the_fly.py --method rpsh --beads 1
methods.gaps: The existing inputs are short population demonstrations. Full paper scattering requires a momentum scan, incident wavepacket or corresponding ring initial density, channel classification and sufficient propagation time. Tully III has nonvanishing asymptotic coupling on one side, so vanishing coupling is not a general stopping criterion.
methods.availability: CLI methods rpsh and rpsh-ca; direct adiabatic API
methods.name_zh: FSSH 与质心近似 RPSH
methods.scope_zh: 实固定 diabatic 的 RPSHDynamics、扩展 CA 类和直接 adiabatic 接口均共用一个环活动面；P=1 是经典核 FSSH 极限。动量重标、受阻跃迁及初态约定应与目标论文一致。
methods.original_system_zh: Tully 1990 的三个一维两态散射模型；Shushkov–Li–Tully 2012 的两态热散射速率；Shakib–Huo 2017 的低动量 Tully 反射/透射研究。
reproduce_observables_zh: 四个最终通道的反射/透射几率以及它们随 p0 的变化
active-surface 分数、振幅布居和电子相干分别保存，不能互相替代
若复现 2012 热速率，还需入射通量和热平均，而不是直接将末态分数称为速率
methods.gaps_zh: 现成输入是短时布居示例。完整原文散射需要动量扫描、入射波包或对应环聚合初始分布、终态通道判别与足够传播时间。Tully III 耦合在一侧不消失，不能以耦合趋零作为通用停止条件。

methods.name: Bead-average RPSH (RPSH-BA)
methods.scope: A single electronic amplitude vector driven by bead-averaged energies and velocity-coupling terms, with one common active surface. This is not an independent surface label or wavefunction per bead.
methods.original_system: Shakya et al. 2023 compares CA, BA, and DM for Tully's extended-coupling model (Model C/III), including p0=20 and 30 atomic units, mass 2000, initial centroid x0=-15, width parameter 2, and 64 beads in the reported study.
reproduce_observables: Compare electronic densities, coherences and state-resolved reflection using the same physical preparation as CA/DM
Report both active-surface statistics and electronic amplitude estimators
methods.gaps: The example is not the full paper ensemble. Copy the width, temperature and sampling definitions from the original equations: a width parameter of 2 must not be silently identified with another interface's Gaussian sigma convention.
methods.name_zh: Bead 平均表面跳跃 RPSH-BA
methods.scope_zh: 只有一组电子振幅，由各 bead 的能量和速度耦合项平均驱动；整条环共用活动态，并非每个 bead 单独选电子面。
methods.original_system_zh: Shakya 等人 2023：Tully 扩展耦合模型 C/III，对比 CA、BA、DM；报告的条件包括 p0=20/30 au、质量 2000、初始质心 −15、宽度参数 2 和 64 beads。宽度的公式定义须与原文一致。
reproduce_observables_zh: 与 CA/DM 使用同一物理初态，比较电子密度、相干和分态反射几率
同时报告 active-surface 统计和电子振幅估计量
methods.gaps_zh: 示例并非完整原文轨迹集。需从原文复制 width/温度/采样定义，不能把数字 2 直接混同任何 Gaussian sigma 约定；应按原文公式构造核初态。

methods.name: Density-matrix RPSH (RPSH-DM)
methods.scope: Each bead has an electronic amplitude vector; bead densities are transported to a common centroid basis and averaged. The ring still has a common active surface. The reduced density can lose purity from bead averaging. No additional EDC is allowed in this DM variant.
methods.original_system: Same Tully III/Model C settings as the BA row, directly from the 2023 CA/BA/DM comparison.
reproduce_observables: rho_ij(t), Tr(rho^2), and coherence decay, alongside channel-resolved reflection/transmission
Verify phase/unitary-basis invariance separately, distinguishing bead mixing from numerical phase errors
methods.gaps: Total populations alone do not test the paper's decoherence claims: include its density-matrix observables. Correct the existing guides' first-author initial from P. Shakya to Y. Shakya.
methods.name_zh: 密度矩阵表面跳跃 RPSH-DM
methods.scope_zh: 各 bead 独立传播电子振幅，密度变换至共同质心基底后平均，因此可出现纯度降低；环仍共用活动面。此变体不叠加 EDC。
methods.original_system_zh: 同一 Shakya 等人 2023 Tully III/模型 C 的 CA、BA、DM 直接比较，重点包括电子密度和去相干。
reproduce_observables_zh: rho_ij(t)、Tr rho²、相干衰减，配合通道分辨反射/透射
单独验证基底相位/幺正变换不改变可观测量，区别真实 bead 混合与数值相位错误
methods.gaps_zh: 仅比较总布居不足以验证原文主张；要加入原文的密度矩阵与去相干量。原指南的参考文献作者 P. Shakya 应修正为 Y. Shakya。

methods.name: Energy-based decoherence correction (EDC)
methods.scope: Inactive electronic amplitudes are damped using energy-gap-dependent times and the active component is renormalized with its phase retained. RPSH uses explicit centroid or ring energy conventions. Supported in CA/BA, not as an extra DM correction.
methods.original_system: Granucci–Persico2007: azobenzene photoisomerization and two deliberately designed model problems.
reproduce_observables: Internal consistency between electronic amplitude populations and active-state statistics
Decoherence timescales and reaction branching in the paper's models; Tully III can serve as an initial package regression substitute
methods.existing_entry: RPSHDynamics(..., decoherence='edc', ...) and advanced CA/BA options documented in docs/nonadiabatic-hopping-extensions.md
methods.gaps: Tully III is a practical substitute regression system, not the original 2007 paper's system. Reproducing azobenzene requires consistent electronic-structure theory, initial conditions and potential data.
methods.name_zh: 能量型去相干修正 EDC
methods.scope_zh: 按能隙和所选动能定义阻尼非活动态振幅，并保留活动振幅相位地重新归一化；RPSH 的质心/全环能量是显式适配约定。支持 CA/BA，不作为 DM 的额外修正。
methods.original_system_zh: Granucci–Persico 2007：偶氮苯光异构化和两个专门设计的模型问题。Tully III 只能作为包内替代回归体系。
reproduce_observables_zh: 电子振幅布居与 active-state 统计的内部一致性
原文模型的去相干时间尺度与反应分支；可先以 Tully III 作包内回归替代体系
methods.gaps_zh: Tully III 是实用的替代回归体系，不能称为该 2007 论文原始体系。真实 azobenzene 复现还需一致的电子结构级别、初始态与势能数据。

methods.name: Complex/SOC RPSH and local geometric force
methods.scope: Complex Hermitian fixed-diabatic Hamiltonians; complex NAC is reduced to a real rescaling direction using Miao et al. method 2. Optional antisymmetric Berry-force update uses a Cayley rotation. This is a local nondegenerate correction, not a full geometric-phase interference treatment or a degenerate/non-Abelian SOC algorithm.
methods.original_system: Miao–Bellonzi–Subotnik2019: two-dimensional two-state complex Hamiltonian with theta(x)=pi/2[erf(Bx)+1], phi(y)=Wy and flat adiabatic energies ±A. The first illustrated case uses A=0.1, B=3, W=0.3.
reproduce_observables: First reproduce transverse momentum deflection and state-resolved scattering in the paper at P=1
Compare with and without Berry force against a two-dimensional wavepacket reference, and check constant-phase invariance
Treat the P>1 ring-polymer extension as a subsequent method comparison, not as the original 2019 calculation
methods.gaps: The current example is a synthetic complex-LVC model, not molecular intersystem crossing. The paper's two-dimensional potential and quantum benchmark need separate implementation; the package's SplitOperator1D cannot supply that reference.
methods.name_zh: 复 Hermitian / SOC 表面跳跃与局域几何力
methods.scope_zh: 按 Miao 等人 method 2 从复 NAC 选择实动量重标方向，并可用 Cayley 旋转加入反对称 Berry 力。限局域非简并修正，不等同完整几何相位干涉或简并态非 Abelian 算法。
methods.original_system_zh: Miao–Bellonzi–Subotnik 2019：二维两态复矩阵，θ(x)=π[erf(Bx)+1]/2、φ(y)=Wy，绝热面为常数 ±A；首个展示条件 A=0.1、B=3、W=0.3。
reproduce_observables_zh: 先以 P=1 复现原文的横向动量偏转与态分辨散射概率
比较有/无 Berry force，并用二维波包参考验证；检查常相位变换不变性
P>1 的环聚合扩展作为后续新比较，不能等同于 2019 原文
methods.gaps_zh: 当前示例是合成 complex-LVC 模型，不是实际分子的 intersystem crossing。原文二维势与二维量子基准需要另行实现；包内 SplitOperator1D 无法提供这一二维参考。

methods.name: Projected DBOC correction for RPSH
methods.scope: Included-state projected DBOC sum |d_ij|²/(2m) with finite-difference gradients of the scalar correction; it modifies both nuclear forces and hopping gaps. Truncated-state and near-degeneracy limits must be explicit. Accuracy improvement is regime dependent.
methods.original_system: Limbu et al. 2025: Debye spin-boson bath discretized into 100 modes, symmetric/asymmetric cases, 300 and 30 K, and scans of reorganization strength and bath response time; compared with HEOM.
reproduce_observables: Donor population P_D(t) with and without DBOC, compared with HEOM
Use the paper's mixed quantum/classical population estimator: active-state diagonal terms plus amplitude coherences
Converge beads, timestep, bath discretization and the finite-difference displacement for DBOC gradients separately
methods.gaps: The short example is not the paper's Debye-bath/HEOM study. AdvancedRPSHDynamics.density_matrix explicitly returns amplitude density rather than the paper's mixed population estimator. Implement that observable for a paper-curve comparison; do not substitute |c|^2 or a generic saved density.
methods.availability: CLI and Python API; paper-observable pipeline requires work
methods.name_zh: 投影对角 Born–Oppenheimer 修正 RPSH
methods.scope_zh: 计算所含电子态的 Σ|d_ij|²/(2m) 并差分其梯度，同时修正核力和跃迁能隙。截断态、近简并和差分步长限制应注明；效果随动力学区间变化。
methods.original_system_zh: Limbu 等人 2025：100 模离散 Debye spin-boson 浴，300 K 和 30 K，对称/非对称势以及重组强度和浴响应时间扫描，与 HEOM 比较。
reproduce_observables_zh: 有/无 DBOC 时的 donor population P_D(t)，与 HEOM 参考比较
使用论文的混合量子/经典布居估计量：active-state 对角项加振幅的非对角相干项
beads、时间步、浴离散化和 DBOC 梯度差分步长分别收敛
methods.gaps_zh: 现成短时示例不是论文的 Debye bath/HEOM 实验。AdvancedRPSHDynamics.density_matrix 明确返回振幅密度而非论文的混合布居估计量，因此原文曲线比较必须补该观测量；不能直接用 |c|² 或一般 saved density 替代。

methods.name: Classical IESH and centroid RP-IESH (CLI methods iesh, rp-iesh)
methods.scope: One spinless Slater determinant of independent electrons in a discretized metal band; nuclei move on the bare energy plus occupied orbital energies with fewest-switches single-excitation hops. RP-IESH shares one determinant across the ring and propagates electrons at the centroid. Real Hamiltonians with nondegenerate levels; one-particle density populations; not a GPU or native full-trajectory solver.
methods.original_system: Shenvi–Roy–Tully 2009: vibrational relaxation of NO on Au(111) with a DFT-fitted multistate PES. Gardner et al. 2023 analyse IESH on model Hamiltonians and full-dimensional atomistic systems, including scattering and desorption probabilities.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare zero-temperature populations with a Fock-space/Fourier reference for the Newns–Anderson-type model; report band discretization, hop statistics, energy conservation and timestep convergence; then compare scattering or desorption probabilities with Gardner et al. for the same model parameters.
methods.gaps: The NO/Au(111) PES is not bundled. RP-IESH follows the centroid extension described in Gardner's thesis; finite-band limits, thermostatting of the metal and the ring-polymer extension need system-specific convergence.
methods.name_zh: 经典 IESH 与质心 RP-IESH（命令行 iesh、rp-iesh）
methods.scope_zh: 离散金属能带中独立电子的单个无自旋 Slater 行列式；核在裸能量加占据轨道能之和上运动，按最少跳跃做单激发跳跃。RP-IESH 整条环共用一个行列式并在质心传播电子。限实哈密顿量、非简并能级；输出单粒子密度布居；不是 GPU 或原生全轨迹求解器。
methods.original_system_zh: Shenvi–Roy–Tully 2009：基于 DFT 拟合多态势能面的 NO 在 Au(111) 上的振动弛豫；Gardner 等 2023 在模型哈密顿量和全维原子体系上分析 IESH，包括散射与脱附概率。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 对 Newns–Anderson 型模型将零温布居与 Fock 空间/Fourier 参考比较；报告能带离散、跳跃统计、能量守恒与时间步收敛；再用相同模型参数与 Gardner 等的散射或脱附概率比较。
methods.gaps_zh: 未提供 NO/Au(111) 势能面。RP-IESH 依据 Gardner 博士论文描述的质心扩展；有限能带极限、金属热浴与环聚合物扩展都需要针对具体体系收敛。

methods.name: Quasi-diabatic NRPMD and adiabatic on-the-fly provider
methods.scope: AdiabaticResult/AdiabaticPythonPotential carry energies, gradients, NACs and overlaps. QDNRPMDDynamics transports mapping coordinates through local bases, with closest-unitary overlap transport and offdiagonal gradient reconstruction. This combines the QD representation strategy with NRPMD; it does not implement the original papers' PLDM/SQC algorithms. Declared continuous-gauge endpoint-NAC transport is an approximation when true overlaps are absent.
methods.original_system: 2018 QD paper: model/condensed-phase demonstrations with its own nonadiabatic propagators. 2019 on-the-fly paper: ethylene excited-state photodeactivation using CASSCF electronic data and QD-PLDM/SQC.
reproduce_observables: First use a complete analytic two-state model to check QD/fixed-diabatic NRPMD equivalence, phase invariance, overlap singular values and energy consistency
For a real molecule, record S1 populations, ground-state recovery and conical-intersection pathway branching against references with the same electronic theory and preparation
methods.gaps: The current example is an analytic two-state interface demonstration. Reproducing the original ethylene study requires matching CASSCF data, overlaps/NACs, preparation and PLDM/SQC propagation. Current NRPMD curves are a different-method comparison on that system. A generic Python provider does not automatically supply a portable electronic-structure restart.
methods.name_zh: 准 diabatic NRPMD 与即时绝热电子结构接口
methods.scope_zh: provider 提供能量、梯度、NAC 和态重叠；用局域基底重叠传输映射变量及重建非对角梯度。QDNRPMD 是 QD 策略与 NRPMD 的组合，并未实现原文的 PLDM/SQC。缺少真实重叠时的 endpoint-NAC 传输属于额外近似。
methods.original_system_zh: Mandal 等人 2018 的 QD 模型/凝聚相演示；Zhou 等人 2019 用 CASSCF 电子数据研究乙烯激发态失活，所用动力学为 QD-PLDM/SQC。
reproduce_observables_zh: 先在完整两态解析模型上验证 QD 与固定 diabatic NRPMD 的等价、相位不变性、重叠奇异值及能量一致性
真实分子阶段记录 S1 布居、基态恢复时间和 conical-intersection 途径分支，并与相同电子结构/初始化条件的参考比较
methods.gaps_zh: 当前是解析两态接口演示。真实 ethylene 原文复现需要相同 CASSCF 数据、态重叠/NAC、初始态和 PLDM/SQC 实现；当前 NRPMD 结果只能称为在同一体系上的方法比较。通用 Python provider 不自动提供可移植的电子结构重启。

methods.name: Online excited-state providers and overlap-derived couplings
methods.scope: ExcitedStateProvider supplies total state energies, positive gradients, derivative couplings, adjacent-frame overlaps, state tracking and a restartable electronic context to existing adiabatic consumers (for example AdiabaticRPSHDynamics). Couplings from overlaps use the Hammes-Schiffer–Tully finite difference or the multistate generalized NPI after Löwdin orthogonalization. PySCF TDA/TDDFT is tested; ORCA, Q-Chem and OpenMolcas file adapters are parser- and mock-tested only. It does not select a dynamics method.
methods.original_system: Hammes-Schiffer–Tully 1994: proton transfer in a model of liquid methyl chloride. Meek–Levine 2014: the Landau–Zener model. Jain–Alguire–Subotnik 2016 is an algorithm paper for large-scale surface hopping. PySCF is software.
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare overlap-derived time-derivative couplings with analytic couplings on the Landau–Zener and toy models; report transition probabilities against exact results, phase/state-tracking diagnostics, and timestep and retained-state convergence for a PySCF molecule.
methods.gaps: The external ORCA/Q-Chem/OpenMolcas executables are untested. Two-frame couplings determine only the component along the displacement, which is not a full NAC vector for arbitrary momentum rescaling. Cite the electronic-structure method, functional and basis separately.
methods.name_zh: 在线激发态计算接口与基于重叠的耦合
methods.scope_zh: ExcitedStateProvider 向已有绝热动力学（如 AdiabaticRPSHDynamics）提供各态总能量、正梯度、导数耦合、相邻帧重叠、态追踪和可续跑的电子上下文。由重叠得到耦合时采用 Hammes-Schiffer–Tully 有限差分，或在 Löwdin 正交化后采用多态广义 NPI。PySCF TDA/TDDFT 已测试；ORCA、Q-Chem、OpenMolcas 文件适配器仅经解析与模拟子进程测试。该接口不选择动力学方法。
methods.original_system_zh: Hammes-Schiffer–Tully 1994：液态氯甲烷模型中的质子转移；Meek–Levine 2014：Landau–Zener 模型；Jain–Alguire–Subotnik 2016 是大规模面跳跃算法论文；PySCF 为软件。
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在 Landau–Zener 和玩具模型上把基于重叠的时间导数耦合与解析耦合比较；报告与精确结果对照的跃迁概率、相位/态追踪诊断，以及 PySCF 分子的时间步和保留态数收敛。
methods.gaps_zh: ORCA/Q-Chem/OpenMolcas 外部程序尚未实测。两帧耦合只确定沿位移方向的分量，不能代替任意动量重标所需的完整 NAC 矢量。电子结构方法、泛函和基组需另行引用。

methods.name: Mapping-variable RPMD (MV-RPMD)
methods.scope: Real fixed-diabatic multistate signed projected-Wigner trace product; sample absolute weight and retain signs. The package uses exact finite-bead electronic matrix exponentials, unlike the original primitive short-time approximation. Nonseparable electronic flow uses implicit midpoint; trace nodes/sign crossings are rejected. CPU model API.
methods.original_system: Ananth2013 Table I: four one-dimensional coupled harmonic two-state models, V0=R²/2, V11=R+c, V22=-R, V12=Delta, beta=M=k=a=1, with (c,Delta)=(0,0.1),(0,1),(0,10),(3,0.1).
reproduce_observables: Position autocorrelation C_RR(t) compared with exact DVR
Stationarity of equilibrium nuclear/electronic statistics, average sign and independent-sample uncertainty
Assess differences between finite-bead electronic discretizations after controlling bead convergence
methods.existing_entry: python examples/nonadiabatic/method_models.py; MVRPMDPotential, MVRPMDSampler, and MVRPMDDynamics APIs
methods.gaps: method_models.py is a teaching entry. Add all four published parameter sets, thermal sampling, correlation analysis and a DVR benchmark. Differences between finite-bead short-time electronic approximations must not be misclassified as implementation errors.
methods.name_zh: 映射变量环聚合动力学 MV-RPMD
methods.scope_zh: 实固定 diabatic 多态 signed projected-Wigner trace 采样，保留符号。包使用精确有限 bead 电子矩阵指数，原文使用 primitive 短时近似；非可分电子流用 implicit midpoint，遇 trace 节点/符号跨越报错。
reproduce_observables_zh: 位置自相关 C_RR(t) 与精确 DVR 比较
位置和电子平衡统计的稳定性、平均 sign 与独立样本误差
检查 bead 收敛后不同有限 bead 电子离散方式对曲线的影响
methods.gaps_zh: method_models.py 是教学入口；需补四组原文参数、热采样、相关函数与 DVR benchmark 驱动。不能将有限 bead 的不同电子短时近似误差误判为代码错误。

methods.name: Kinetically constrained RPMD (KC-RPMD)
methods.scope: Original primitive two-state construction, positive electronic coupling, explicit a/b parameters and crossing calibration eta/auxiliary mass. Current limits include 0<a<=1, b>0, P>=2 and beta*K/P<1. No later KC variants are implicitly implemented.
methods.original_system: Menzeleev–Bell–Miller2014: model A is one-dimensional unbound two-state scattering with temperature-dependent rates; model B is condensed-phase electron transfer with a solvent coordinate and a harmonic bath, scanning coupling and driving force into normal/inverted regimes.
reproduce_observables: Temperature-dependent rate k(T) for model A
Model B rates versus electronic coupling K and driving force, spanning nonadiabatic and adiabatic limits
Crossing calibration, auxiliary-coordinate free energy and a flux-side transmission plateau computed separately
methods.existing_entry: python examples/nonadiabatic/method_models.py; KCCalibration, KCRPMDPotential, KCRPMDSampler and KCRPMDDynamics APIs
methods.gaps: The existing demonstration is not a quantitative paper-rate reproduction. Supply physically consistent crossing averages, eta and auxiliary mass; a normalized rate benchmark with the paper's parameters remains to be built. Do not tune a/b or auxiliary mass merely to fit a reference curve.
methods.name_zh: 动力学约束环聚合方法 KC-RPMD
methods.scope_zh: 实现原始 primitive 两态正耦合构造，用户给定 a/b、交叉校准 η 与辅助质量。限 0<a≤1、b>0、P≥2、βK/P<1；不自动包含后续 KC 变体。
methods.original_system_zh: Menzeleev–Bell–Miller 2014：模型 A 为一维两态非束缚散射的温度依赖速率；模型 B 为溶剂反应坐标加谐振浴的凝聚相电子转移，扫描耦合与正常/倒转区驱动力。
reproduce_observables_zh: model A 的 k(T)
model B 的速率随电子耦合 K 与驱动力的变化，比较非绝热和绝热极限
分别计算 crossing calibration、auxiliary-coordinate 自由能与 flux-side 透射平台
methods.gaps_zh: 现成演示不是论文的定量速率复现。用户必须提供物理一致的 crossing 平均、eta 和辅助质量；还缺对应原文参数化的标准化速率 benchmark。不能随意调 a/b 或辅助质量来贴合曲线。

methods.name: Two-state isomorphic potential with Ehrenfest dynamics
methods.scope: Real two-state trace-matched whole-ring isomorphic Hamiltonian and an explicit Ehrenfest consumer with a single normalized electronic wavefunction. The sum-bead convention carries the factor P explicitly. This is neither the paper's QCLE dynamics nor iso-surface-hopping, and is not a general multistate implementation.
methods.original_system: Tao–Shushkov–Miller2018 studies a shifted quartic two-state model, a three-state donor–bridge–acceptor harmonic model, and two-state scattering; reported dynamical applications use QCLE/CMD or SH-RP-iso.
reproduce_observables: First reproduce the per-ring electronic Boltzmann trace identity, isomorphic coupling and analytic/finite-difference gradients for the paper's two-state potential
Reproduce paper correlation functions or state-resolved rates only after implementing the corresponding QCLE or iso-SH propagator
methods.existing_entry: python examples/nonadiabatic/method_models.py; IsomorphicPotential and IsomorphicEhrenfestDynamics APIs
methods.gaps: The present Ehrenfest curves must not be called reproductions of the paper's QCLE/iso-SH curves. Its three-state donor-bridge-acceptor model also exceeds the current two-state implementation. No implicit thermal sampler is supplied.
methods.availability: Python model API; trace identity ready, paper dynamics incomplete
methods.name_zh: 两态同构势与 Ehrenfest 动力学
methods.scope_zh: 实现实两态、整环 trace 匹配的 isomorphic Hamiltonian，再用单一归一化电子波函数做 Ehrenfest。不是原文 QCLE 或 iso-surface-hopping，也不含通用多态构造或隐含热采样。
methods.original_system_zh: Tao–Shushkov–Miller 2018：平移四次两态模型、三态 donor–bridge–acceptor 谐振模型、两态散射；论文动力学图使用 QCLE/CMD 或 SH-RP-iso。
reproduce_observables_zh: 优先复现两态势的逐环电子 Boltzmann trace 恒等式、isomorphic coupling 和解析/有限差分梯度
在独立实现对应 QCLE 或 iso-SH 后再复现论文的相关函数或态分辨速率
methods.gaps_zh: 当前 Ehrenfest 曲线不能标为原文 QCLE/iso-SH 曲线的复现；三态 donor–bridge–acceptor 也超出现有两态范围。没有隐含热初态采样器。

methods.name: Tully I/II/III analytic matrix potentials
methods.scope: Analytic value/gradient implementations TullyModelOne, TullyModelTwo and TullyModelThree, corresponding to the original models. Nuclear mass is a system/sampling choice, not encoded by choosing a potential class.
methods.original_system: The three one-dimensional two-state models from Tully1990: single avoided crossing, dual avoided crossing, and extended coupling with reflection. The conventional benchmark nuclear mass is 2000 atomic units.
reproduce_observables: Check potential matrices and derivatives against the original equations before momentum scans and four-channel scattering probabilities
Compare exact wavepackets, P=1 FSSH/MASH and P>1 RPSH under the same physical preparation
methods.existing_entry: TullyModelOne/Two/Three APIs and documented saved-workflow model identities in docs/nonadiabatic-models.md
methods.gaps: Available potential classes do not constitute a complete scattering benchmark. Specify incident distributions, width conventions, stopping regions and unclassified/trapped trajectories. Model III's offdiagonal coupling tends to 2b on one side, so coupling cannot be required to vanish in every asymptotic region.
methods.name_zh: Tully I/II/III 解析矩阵势
methods.scope_zh: 实现单避免交叉、双避免交叉和扩展耦合反射三种势及解析导数。核质量属于 system/采样配置，不会由势类自动指定。
methods.original_system_zh: Tully 1990 的三个一维两态散射模型，常用基准核质量为 2000 au。
reproduce_observables_zh: 势能矩阵和导数先对原文方程核对，再做入射动量扫描和四通道散射概率
把精确波包、P=1 FSSH/MASH、P>1 RPSH 等在同一物理初态下比较
methods.gaps_zh: 势函数存在不等于散射 benchmark 完整。需定义入射分布、宽度约定、停止区域和未分类/滞留轨迹。模型 III 的远区 offdiagonal coupling 一侧趋于 2b，不可要求所有区域耦合为零。

methods.name: Generic LVC / discrete spin-boson matrix models and harmonic ring preparation
methods.scope: LinearVibronicCoupling and DiscreteSpinBoson are generic parameter containers with analytic gradients, not a uniquely published model. Harmonic preparation samples an explicitly declared finite-P uncoupled harmonic initial density; it does not infer the coupled system's thermal density. Cite the parameter source for the selected application.
methods.original_system: Parameter-dependent: one-mode models from the cited NRPMD/SM-NRPMD papers are useful initial targets. No bundled generic LVC parameter set is automatically the paper's pyrazine/FMO Hamiltonian; a discrete bath also needs an explicitly chosen spectral-density discretization.
reproduce_observables: Compare initial harmonic-ring covariance with analytic finite-P values, declaring active coordinates and treatment of zero-frequency spectators
After selecting a paper's complete matrix parameters, compute its corresponding populations or equilibrium correlations
Confirm that tunnelling is the offdiagonal matrix element, with no hidden factor of one half
methods.gaps: No single original-model citation applies to all arbitrary LVC parameters. An uncoupled harmonic initial density represents vertical switching/excitation, not coupled equilibrium; free spectators also lack a normalizable canonical position distribution.
methods.name_zh: 通用 LVC / 离散 spin-boson 与谐振环初态
methods.scope_zh: LVC 和离散 spin-boson 是参数化容器，须为每个应用另引参数来源。harmonic ring 采样是显式声明的有限 P 非耦合谐振初态，不自动给出耦合系统热平衡密度，也未内置特定 pyrazine/FMO 参数或通用浴离散规则。
methods.original_system_zh: 可先选择 NRPMD 2019 或 SM-NRPMD 2021 的完整单模模型。任意 LVC 教学参数不能直接称为这些论文的模型；浴模型还需匹配谱密度离散方案。
reproduce_observables_zh: 初始 harmonic ring 协方差对解析 finite-P 值；明确 active 坐标和零频 spectator 的处理
选择某篇论文的完整矩阵参数后，再计算对应布居或热相关函数
核查 tunnelling 参数就是矩阵 offdiagonal 元素，不带隐含 1/2 因子
methods.gaps_zh: 不能为所有任意 LVC 参数统一挂一篇原始模型论文。uncoupled harmonic initial density 是垂直开关/激发预备，不是 coupled equilibrium；自由 spectator 也没有归一化 canonical 位置分布。

methods.name: NaH2 LEPS-5G coupled diabatic potential
methods.scope: Historical neutral NaH2 two-state doublet potential for the two lowest 2A' surfaces, with analytic matrix derivatives. Cite the physical PES and erratum separately from any ChemPotPy software/adaptor credit.
methods.original_system: Na(3p 2P)+H2 electronic quenching to Na(3s 2S)+H2 or reaction to NaH+H.
reproduce_observables: First verify reactant/product asymptotic energies, adiabatic surface cuts, derivatives/couplings and the crossing region
Then specify collision energy and the H2 rovibrational initial state to calculate quenching/reactive branches or state-resolved scattering cross sections
methods.gaps: The current molecular example is short propagation, not a reproduction of the original scattering study. Match PES parameters/erratum, state preparation and trajectory statistics; separately assess nondegenerate hopping algorithms near the crossing region.
methods.availability: Built-in molecular matrix PES and CLI example
methods.name_zh: NaH₂ LEPS-5G 两态 diabatic 势
methods.scope_zh: 历史中性 NaH₂ 的两个最低双重态 ²A′ 耦合势及矩阵导数；应同时引用物理 PES 原文与勘误，软件适配器引用单列。
methods.original_system_zh: Na(3p ²P)+H₂ 发生电子淬灭生成 Na(3s ²S)+H₂，或反应生成 NaH+H。
reproduce_observables_zh: 先核验反应物/产物渐近能、绝热面切片、导数与耦合以及交叉区域
再定义入射能与 H2 初始 rovibrational 状态，计算 quenching/reactive branching 或态分辨散射截面
methods.gaps_zh: 当前分子例子只是短时传播，不是原始散射研究的重现。需同一 PES 参数/勘误、态预备和足够轨迹统计；非简并跳跃算法在交叉区域的适用性也要单独评估。

methods.name: Finite-domain matrix split-operator quantum reference
methods.scope: SplitOperator1D uses a uniform periodic Fourier grid, exact pointwise Hermitian matrix exponentials and symmetric second-order splitting. Supports pure states and canonical harmonic mixtures. It has no absorbing boundary or general multidimensional propagator. A converged numerical reference must control box, grid, time step and thermal truncation independently.
methods.original_system: The Feit–Fleck–Steiger paper establishes the spectral method. The repository's present comparison is a synthetic one-mode two-state LVC vertical switch with beta=2; this is a package regression system, not a claimed reproduction of a particular figure from the 1982 paper.
reproduce_observables: Cross-check analytic Rabi oscillations, free-Gaussian translation/spreading and an independent dense-Hamiltonian exponential
Populations P_i(t) for the target one-dimensional matrix model, with separate timestep/grid/box sensitivities and boundary probability
Report NRPMD method differences separately from finite-bead and sampling errors; agreement of approximate NRPMD with quantum dynamics is not an implementation-correctness requirement
methods.gaps: --smoke uses only 16 trajectories, 8 beads and short propagation, and does not establish physical convergence. Avoid periodic wraparound in scattering calculations; the two-dimensional SOC paper requires a separate multidimensional quantum reference.
methods.name_zh: 有限区域矩阵分裂算符量子基准
methods.scope_zh: 一维周期 Fourier 网格加逐点 Hermitian 矩阵指数和二阶对称分裂，支持纯态及谐振热混合态。没有吸收边界和通用多维传播；需分别收敛空间区域、网格、时间步与热截断。
methods.original_system_zh: Feit–Fleck–Steiger 1982 是谱传播方法来源。仓库当前合成单模两态 LVC、β=2 的垂直开关 benchmark 是包内回归体系，并非该 1982 论文某图的原始体系。
reproduce_observables_zh: 解析 Rabi 振荡、自由 Gaussian 平移/展宽和独立稠密 Hamiltonian 指数的交叉验证
目标一维矩阵模型的 P_i(t)；分别记录 dt、grid、box 改变后的敏感度以及边缘概率
NRPMD 方法偏差与其有限 beads、抽样误差分开报告；不把 approximate NRPMD=quantum 作为代码正确性要求
methods.gaps_zh: --smoke 仅 16 trajectories/8 beads/短时，不能标为物理收敛。散射需避免周期边界回卷；二维 SOC 论文需要另外的二维量子参考。

methods.name: Isotropic BZP NPT PIMD
methods.name_zh: 各向同性 BZP 恒压 PIMD
methods.scope: Centroid-only dilation with physical virial and PIMD measure correction; all-mobile 3D periodic cells.
methods.scope_zh: 只缩放质心，使用物理位力及 PIMD 系综测度修正；要求三维周期且全部原子可动。
methods.original_system: BZP: Lennard-Jones liquid/solid near the triple point. i-PI: supercritical water at 750 K and 10 GPa.
methods.original_system_zh: BZP 原文：三相点附近的 Lennard-Jones 液体/晶体；i-PI 原文：750 K、10 GPa 超临界水。
methods.reproduce_observables: Mean and variance of volume, pressure, volume autocorrelation, timestep and piston-relaxation dependence; compare P=1 before PIMD.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先做 P=1，比较体积均值/方差、压力与体积自相关，再做 PIMD；扫描步长及活塞时间常数。
methods.gaps: Existing ideal-gas controls are substitutes. Obtain the paper potential and full thermodynamic protocol; NPT trajectories are not diffusion production.
methods.gaps_zh: 已有理想气体控制算例是替代测试。须取得原文势函数及系综参数；恒压采样时间不能直接当扩散动力学时间。

methods.name: Flexible-cell MTTK/MTK PIMD
methods.name_zh: 柔性晶胞 MTTK/MTK PIMD
methods.scope: Upper-triangular strain-rate matrix and lower-triangular row-vector cell; hydrostatic pressure, optional cell mask.
methods.scope_zh: 上三角应变率、下三角行晶格矢量；静水压及可选晶胞分量掩码。
methods.original_system: Constant-pressure PIMD paper: periodic model particle, liquid/solid para-hydrogen and liquid butane.
methods.original_system_zh: 恒压 PIMD 原文：周期势中的模型粒子、液态/固态 para-H2、液态丁烷。
methods.reproduce_observables: Cell/volume distribution, pressure tensor and equilibrium energies; compare identical cells and reference-engine equations.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 比较晶胞/体积分布、压力张量和平衡能量；对齐晶胞约定与参考实现。
methods.gaps: Paper force fields and full inputs must be supplied; masked cell motion does not establish a slab NPT ensemble.
methods.gaps_zh: 须补原文力场与输入；限制某些晶胞自由度不等于已验证的薄层恒压系综。

methods.name: Raiteri–Gale–Bussi stress coupling
methods.name_zh: RGB 外应力耦合
methods.scope: Reference-cell strain-energy model with explicit symmetric external stress.
methods.scope_zh: 显式对称外应力及参考晶胞应变能模型。
methods.original_system: Pure and Y-doped BaZrO3 proton diffusion with an EVB force field.
methods.original_system_zh: 纯 BaZrO3 与 Y 掺杂 BaZrO3 中的质子扩散，使用 EVB 力场。
methods.reproduce_observables: First cell/strain statistics under imposed stress; only then proton residence times and diffusion with the original EVB model.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先检查应力下晶胞/应变统计，再用原文 EVB 力场计算质子驻留时间和扩散。
methods.gaps: The paper's EVB material model is not bundled; external-stress coupling alone does not reproduce its diffusion result.
methods.gaps_zh: 仓库未附该材料 EVB 势；只有外应力算法不能复现原文扩散结果。

methods.name: Stochastic cell rescaling
methods.name_zh: 随机晶胞重缩放 SCR
methods.scope: Isotropic P=1 only; square-root-volume stochastic proposal without Metropolis correction.
methods.scope_zh: 仅各向同性 P=1；平方根体积随机提议，无 Metropolis 校正。
methods.original_system: Lennard-Jones fluid; the original paper also tests a membrane with an anisotropic variant.
methods.original_system_zh: 原文包含 Lennard-Jones 流体及各向异性膜体系。
methods.reproduce_observables: Volume mean/variance and relaxation versus timestep and coupling time; use isotropic liquid for the supported method.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 在支持的各向同性液体上扫描步长/耦合时间，比较体积均值、方差及弛豫。
methods.gaps: Do not use P>1 or call this the paper's anisotropic membrane algorithm; finite-step bias must be measured.
methods.gaps_zh: 不能用于 P>1，也不能称为原文的各向异性膜算法；须测量有限步长偏差。

methods.name: RPMD MSD/VACF diffusion and tensor analysis
methods.name_zh: RPMD 扩散、MSD/VACF 与张量分析
methods.scope: Unwrapped centroids, Einstein and Green–Kubo estimates, replica/block uncertainty; material applications supplement the foundational RPMD citation.
methods.scope_zh: 展开质心的 Einstein/Green–Kubo 估计及副本/分块误差；材料应用论文与基础 RPMD 文献同时引用。
methods.original_system: Ni(100)/H EAM (2012); flexible Pd(111)/H with a DFT-trained neural potential (2024).
methods.original_system_zh: 2012 年 Ni(100)/H 的 EAM 体系；2024 年柔性 Pd(111)/H 的 DFT 训练神经网络势。
methods.reproduce_observables: D(T), MSD, VACF, site-hop rates and multi-hop correlation; compare fixed/mobile substrate and surface/subsurface channels.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 计算 D(T)、MSD、VACF、位点跃迁和多次跳跃相关性；比较冻结/可动基底及表面/亚表面通道。
methods.gaps: Ni EAM4 is presently a static reference adapter; Pd neural weights/protocol must be obtained. The NiAlH pilot uses a different model.
methods.gaps_zh: Ni EAM4 目前是静态参考适配器；Pd 神经网络权重和参数仍须取得。NiAlH 试算使用另一势模型。

methods.name: Basin-normalized site and surface rates
methods.name_zh: 盆地归一化位点/表面速率
methods.scope: Single-surface reactant-basin normalization; nonlinear all-mobile site coordinates and restricted fixed-substrate surface coordinates have different support.
methods.scope_zh: 单分界面与反应物盆地归一化；全可动位点非线性坐标和固定基底表面坐标的支持范围不同。
methods.original_system: SDS 2025: H+H2, CH3NC isomerization, H recombination on Pt(111), NO desorption on Pd(111). BaZrO3 2008 is a centroid-TST comparison, not RPMD recrossing.
methods.original_system_zh: SDS 2025：H+H2、CH3NC 异构化、Pt(111) 上 H 重组脱附、Pd(111) 上 NO 脱附；BaZrO3 2008 仅作 centroid-TST 对照。
methods.reproduce_observables: Basin partition, PMF barrier, flux factor, k_QTST, kappa(t), final directed rate; compare coordinate/normalization choices.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 计算盆地配分量、PMF 势垒、通量因子、k_QTST、kappa(t) 和有向速率；比较坐标与归一化选择。
methods.gaps: Surface molecular PES and exact reactant-state convention must match; no automatic multi-site kinetic Monte Carlo network.
methods.gaps_zh: 须匹配表面势能面和反应物态约定；当前不自动生成多位点动力学 Monte Carlo 网络。

methods.name: NiAlH EAM pilot potential
methods.name_zh: NiAlH EAM 试算势
methods.scope: External pinned potential table used for an integration pilot.
methods.scope_zh: 使用外部固定版本势表进行集成试算。
methods.original_system: Hydrogen trapping at Ni dislocations and grain boundaries.
methods.original_system_zh: 氢在 Ni 位错及晶界处的俘获。
methods.reproduce_observables: Verify forces/units and defect binding energies before a transport campaign.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先检查力/单位及缺陷结合能，再开展输运计算。
methods.gaps: The small Ni(100) pilot is not the original defect calculation or the 2012 EAM4 diffusion model.
methods.gaps_zh: 小型 Ni(100) 试算不是原文缺陷体系，也不是 2012 年 EAM4 扩散模型。

methods.name: Local golden-rule electrochemical PCET
methods.name_zh: 局域黄金规则电化学 PCET
methods.scope: One grid-resolved proton, fixed donor geometry, constant electronic coupling, wide-band metal and classical Gaussian environment.
methods.scope_zh: 单质子网格本征态、固定供受体构型、常电子耦合、宽带金属及经典 Gaussian 环境。
methods.original_system: 2008 electrode/solute PCET model systems; 2019 application is TEAH+/TEAD+ discharge on Au in acetonitrile.
methods.original_system_zh: 2008 年金属/溶液 PCET 模型；2019 年应用为乙腈中 TEAH+/TEAD+ 在 Au 电极上的放电。
methods.reproduce_observables: Forward/reverse k(U,T), H/D KIE, vibronic-channel contributions; converge proton grid, states and electrode quadrature.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 计算正逆 k(U,T)、H/D KIE、各振电通道贡献；收敛质子网格、能级数及电极能量求积。
methods.gaps: pyPCET agreement is an external implementation check. The local model omits the original application's distance averaging, double layer and broader coupling regimes.
methods.gaps_zh: 与 pyPCET 一致是实现交叉验证；局域模型未覆盖真实体系的距离平均、双电层及更广的耦合区间。

methods.name: Grand-canonical shared-electron HMC/MC
methods.name_zh: 共享电子数的巨正则 HMC/MC
methods.scope: Project composition: nuclear HMC plus bounded continuous shared-N Metropolis moves; MC sweep count has no physical-time meaning.
methods.scope_zh: 项目组合：核坐标 HMC 与有界连续共享电子数 Metropolis 更新；MC 步数不代表物理时间。
methods.original_system: HMC originated in lattice field theory. Related electrode application: 5x5 four-layer Pt(111), 1 ML H, 36 water molecules; GC-(PI)HMC Volmer/Heyrovsky profiles.
methods.original_system_zh: HMC 起源于格点场论；相关电极应用是 5x5 四层 Pt(111)、1 ML H 与 36 个水分子的 GC-(PI)HMC Volmer/Heyrovsky 自由能。
methods.reproduce_observables: Start with analytic charge model: joint q,N distribution, mean/variance of N, acceptance and grand-potential free energy; then classical/quantum interface barriers.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先算解析充电模型的 q,N 联合分布、N 均值/方差、接受率和巨势自由能，再比较界面经典/量子势垒。
methods.gaps: The complete Sun2025 constrained algorithm, DP-Ne model, charge-plate convention and mixed quantization are not supplied by this sampler.
methods.gaps_zh: 此采样器不自动提供 Sun2025 的完整受约束算法、DP-Ne 模型、电荷补偿板或混合量子化设置。

methods.name: Adiabatic constant-potential scalar and matrix wrappers
methods.name_zh: 绝热恒电位标量与矩阵包装
methods.scope: Project approximation: minimize E(R,N)-mu*N independently per geometry; matrix version adds the same scalar charging energy to every diabatic state.
methods.scope_zh: 项目近似：逐构型最小化 E(R,N)-mu*N；矩阵版本给所有透热态加入相同标量充电能。
methods.original_system: No separate original paper for this PyRPMD composition; Sun2025 is physical context, not an identity claim.
methods.original_system_zh: 这一 PyRPMD 组合没有独立原始论文；Sun2025 是物理背景，不能据此宣称算法相同。
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare analytic optimum N*(R), solver residuals, envelope-theorem forces and isotope/voltage free energies.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 比较解析 N*(R)、求解残差、包络定理力，以及同位素/电势相关自由能。
methods.gaps: Independent-bead minima differ from shared-N grand-canonical fluctuations; common charging lacks state-dependent response and is not TP-RPMD.
methods.gaps_zh: 逐珠最优电子数不同于共享电子数涨落；共同充电项没有态依赖响应，也不是 TP-RPMD。

methods.name: Volmer–Heyrovsky–Tafel mean-field postprocessing
methods.name_zh: Volmer–Heyrovsky–Tafel 平均场后处理
methods.scope: Project mass-action balance using externally supplied forward/reverse elementary coefficients and ideal independent sites.
methods.scope_zh: 使用外部给定正逆基元系数及理想独立位点的项目质量作用定律平衡。
methods.original_system: No unique paper for these algebraic balances; electrode papers motivate the elementary reactions only.
methods.original_system_zh: 这些代数平衡没有唯一方法原始论文；电极论文只提供基元反应的物理背景。
methods.reproduce_observables: Coverage theta(U), separate elementary fluxes, H2 TOF, signed current; check steady-state electron/H2 stoichiometry and detailed balance.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 计算 theta(U)、各基元净通量、H2 TOF 和有符号电流；检验稳态计量守恒与详细平衡。
methods.gaps: Does not derive rates from PMFs or local PCET, nor add transport, lateral interactions or double-layer physics.
methods.gaps_zh: 不从 PMF 或局域 PCET 自动推导基元速率，也不包含传质、侧向相互作用或双电层。

methods.name: Markovian centroid electronic-friction RPMD
methods.name_zh: Markov 质心电子摩擦 RPMD
methods.scope: Bead-averaged positive-semidefinite friction acts on centroid; shared random impulse leaves internal modes unthermostatted.
methods.scope_zh: 珠平均半正定摩擦作用于质心；各珠共享随机冲量，内部模不受该浴直接热化。
methods.original_system: Anderson–Holstein chemisorption model, symmetric/asymmetric electron-transfer potentials.
methods.original_system_zh: Anderson–Holstein 化学吸附模型，对称/非对称电子转移势。
methods.reproduce_observables: Nuclear distributions (Fig. 2), population relaxation (Fig. 3), rate versus temperature (Fig. 4), and the asymmetric low-temperature discrepancy (Fig. 5). Match the mean-force model and friction before comparing.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 计算图 2 核分布、图 3 布居弛豫、图 4 温度相关速率及图 5 非对称低温偏差；先匹配平均力势和摩擦。
methods.gaps: Existing corrugated-surface example is a substitute. Build the matching mean-force PES/friction tensor; memory effects and imaginary-time bath renormalization are absent.
methods.gaps_zh: 已有起伏表面示例是替代模型；须构造匹配平均力势和摩擦张量；尚无记忆效应或虚时间浴重整化。

methods.name: PySCF references and on-the-fly force adapter
methods.name_zh: PySCF 参考数据与即时受力接口
methods.scope: Delegates RHF/UHF/RKS/UKS energies, gradients and selected Hessians to external PySCF.
methods.scope_zh: 将 RHF/UHF/RKS/UKS 能量、梯度及所支持 Hessian 委托给外部 PySCF。
methods.original_system: Software interface; no unique physical reproduction system. The selected electronic method, basis and functional require their own citations.
methods.original_system_zh: 软件接口没有唯一物理复现体系；实际电子结构方法、基组和泛函应另外引用。
methods.reproduce_observables: Same-geometry energy/gradient/Hessian versus direct PySCF; finite differences, spin/state continuity and convergence.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 同一构型与直接 PySCF 比较能量/梯度/Hessian，检查差分、自旋/电子态连续性与收敛。
methods.gaps: RHF/STO-3G water is an integration control, not a validated reaction PES.
methods.gaps_zh: RHF/STO-3G 水只是集成控制，不是已验证反应势。

methods.name: Hirshfeld charges and Mayer bond orders
methods.name_zh: Hirshfeld 电荷与 Mayer 键级
methods.scope: Neutral spherical HF stockholder references; unrestricted Mayer includes spin density.
methods.scope_zh: 中性球对称 HF 原子参考的 stockholder 分区；非限制 Mayer 包含自旋密度。
methods.original_system: Original papers define molecular charge/bond indices; current data bridge does not reproduce a complete original numerical table.
methods.original_system_zh: 原文定义分子电荷/键级；当前数据桥接没有声称复现完整原文数表。
methods.reproduce_observables: Charge conservation and grid convergence; compare restricted and open-shell examples against an independent same-convention calculation.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 验证电荷守恒及网格收敛；用闭壳层/开壳层分子对比独立同约定计算。
methods.gaps: Different promolecular atom tables yield different charges; do not compare ORCA defaults as identical definitions.
methods.gaps_zh: 不同自由原子参考表会产生不同电荷，不能把 ORCA 默认值视为同一定义。

methods.name: QMDFF generation
methods.name_zh: QMDFF 势生成
methods.scope: Calls source-pinned upstream Caracal QMDFF generator using equilibrium QM data.
methods.scope_zh: 以平衡构型 QM 数据调用固定源码版本 Caracal QMDFF 生成器。
methods.original_system: Original QMDFF molecular/condensed-phase benchmark suite, parameterized from TPSS-D3/def-TZVP(-f) data; local water is a substitute.
methods.original_system_zh: 原始 QMDFF 的分子/凝聚相基准，基于 TPSS-D3/def-TZVP(-f) 数据；本地水分子算例是替代控制。
methods.reproduce_observables: Compare equilibrium geometry, Hessian frequencies, distorted-geometry energies/forces and dissociation behavior before dynamics.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先比较平衡结构、Hessian 频率、畸变构型能量/力及解离行为，再运行轨迹。
methods.gaps: Requires upstream build and suitable reference theory; recover the chosen original benchmark's SI geometry before claiming reproduction.
methods.gaps_zh: 需要上游编译及合适参考理论；宣称复现前须取得选定原文基准的补充材料结构。

methods.name: dE-EVB / EVB-QMDFF coupling fit
methods.name_zh: dE-EVB / EVB-QMDFF 耦合拟合
methods.scope: Connects endpoint QMDFFs with upstream fitted sp/1g coupling and supplied path energies.
methods.scope_zh: 以给定路径能量及上游 sp/1g 耦合拟合连接端点 QMDFF。
methods.original_system: Original examples include SN2 Cl−+CH3Br → CH3Cl+Br− and ethene+cyclopentadiene → norbornene (Diels–Alder).
methods.original_system_zh: 原文示例包含 SN2：Cl−+CH3Br → CH3Cl+Br−，以及乙烯+环戊二烯 → 降冰片烯的 Diels–Alder 反应。
methods.reproduce_observables: Endpoint limits, coupling, path and off-path energy/force errors, barrier and final RPMD rate relative to the reference PES.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 比较端点极限、耦合、路径内外能量/力误差、势垒及相对参考势的 RPMD 速率。
methods.gaps: The current neutral-only fitting workflow cannot run the charged SN2 case; use a recovered neutral Diels–Alder protocol for a faithful paper-system study. NH3 is a separate package control.
methods.gaps_zh: 当前拟合工作流仅支持中性体系，不能直接运行带电 SN2；忠实原文体系应先恢复中性 Diels–Alder 协议。NH3 是独立仓库控制。

methods.name: TREQ PES generation
methods.name_zh: TREQ 势生成
methods.scope: Upstream reaction-path/quadratic expansion construction; public PyRPMD bridge explicitly uses fourth-order finite-difference forces.
methods.scope_zh: 使用上游反应路径/二阶展开构造；公开桥接明确使用四阶差分力。
methods.original_system: Original six-reaction comparison with analytical full-dimensional reference surfaces; the exact selected SI protocol remains to be transcribed.
methods.original_system_zh: 原文在六个具有解析全维参考势的反应上比较；选定体系的完整补充材料协议尚待转录。
methods.reproduce_observables: Path/off-path energies and gradients, finite-difference step convergence, energy drift, then k(T) against the analytical PES.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 比较路径内外能量/梯度、差分步长收敛、能量漂移，再比较参考解析势上的 k(T)。
methods.gaps: Experimental bridge; the analytic-force inconsistency documented for the pinned source prevents treating its default as the paper's force implementation.
methods.gaps_zh: 桥接处于实验阶段；固定源码的解析力不一致已记录，不能把目前默认力直接等同于原文实现。

methods.name: Linear PIP / PIP-NN fitting and JaxPIP export
methods.name_zh: 线性 PIP / PIP-NN 拟合与 JaxPIP 导出
methods.scope: Explicit train/validation/test data, energy/force loss, upstream JaxPIP descriptors and native ONNX export; exporting a model is separate from validating its PES.
methods.scope_zh: 显式训练/验证/测试集、能量/力损失、JaxPIP 描述符及原生 ONNX 导出；模型导出与势能面验证是不同步骤。
methods.original_system: PIP monomial symmetrization: H3O+ fitted to about 62,000 ab initio energies (Xie–Bowman 2010). PIP-NN 2013: H+H2 and Cl+H2. JaxPIP 2026: 3–9 atom performance tests and OH+CH3OH QCT cross sections/branching (SI Tables S7–S8).
methods.original_system_zh: PIP 单项式对称化：H₃O⁺，约 62,000 个从头算能量点（Xie–Bowman 2010）。PIP-NN 2013：H+H2 与 Cl+H2；JaxPIP 2026：3–9 原子性能测试，以及 OH+CH3OH 的 QCT 截面/分支（SI 表 S7–S8）。
methods.reproduce_observables: Holdout energy/force errors, permutation invariance, Python/native equality and batch scaling; then scattering cross sections with the same trained surface.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 计算留出集能量/力误差、置换不变性、Python/原生一致性及批量性能；再用相同训练势计算散射截面。
methods.gaps: Small H2 examples do not reproduce OH+CH3OH; obtain exact basis/model weights, train split and QCT initial-state convention.
methods.gaps_zh: 小 H2 示例不能复现 OH+CH3OH；须取得准确基函数/权重、数据划分及 QCT 初态约定。

methods.name: Committee uncertainty and acquisition
methods.name_zh: 委员会不确定度与样本采集
methods.scope: Mean of fixed providers, population-standard-deviation disagreement, offline acquisition, and ActiveLearningLoop: sample with a fixed committee, select threshold-crossing candidates within label budgets, label, retrain and install the next committee. Disagreement is not a calibrated error bound; no disagreement bias is applied during sampling.
methods.scope_zh: 固定提供器均值、总体标准差分歧、离线采集，以及 ActiveLearningLoop：用固定委员会采样、在标注预算内选择超阈值候选、标注、重训练并安装下一代委员会。分歧不是经过校准的误差界；采样时不施加分歧偏置。
methods.original_system: Condensed water across liquid state points, ice phases and an air/water interface.
methods.original_system_zh: 跨液体状态点、冰相及气水界面的凝聚相水。
methods.reproduce_observables: Disagreement versus true held-out energy/force error, acquisition enrichment and learning curves with frozen model versions.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 比较分歧与真实留出误差、采样富集效果及学习曲线，固定各阶段模型版本。
methods.gaps: Analytic committee examples test control flow only; external labelled data and training are required.
methods.gaps_zh: 解析势委员会示例只验证流程；须补外部标注数据与训练。

methods.name: Additive delta learning with RPC/MTS
methods.name_zh: 加性 Δ 学习与 RPC/MTS
methods.scope: Adds a supplied correction model to a fixed reference and exposes a fast/slow force split; RPC/MTS have separate method citations.
methods.scope_zh: 将给定校正模型加到固定参考势，并提供快/慢力分解；RPC/MTS 另有方法来源。
methods.original_system: Delta-learning origin: C7H10O2 isomers and organic-molecule thermochemical data, not an RPMD trajectory benchmark.
methods.original_system_zh: Δ 学习原文：C7H10O2 异构体及有机分子热化学数据，不是 RPMD 轨迹基准。
methods.reproduce_observables: Holdout corrected energies and force consistency; for the PyRPMD extension compare full versus contracted corrections in the same observable.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 检验校正后留出能量及力一致性；对 PyRPMD 扩展比较完整与收缩校正的同一观测量。
methods.gaps: Original molecular-property benchmark and dynamics extension are distinct; no trained correction is supplied.
methods.gaps_zh: 原文分子性质基准和动力学扩展不同；仓库不提供训练好的校正势。

methods.gaps_zh: 须提供可选引擎及兼容模型文件；接口不重做上游训练，也不复现其全部应用。

methods.original_system_zh: 这些 PyRPMD 专属机制没有独立原始方法论文；应引用准确 PyRPMD 版本及底层方法/势能面论文。

methods.gaps_zh: 软件测试通过不等于新的物理复现；不能为填满引用栏而附无关论文。

methods.name: Analytic free, harmonic, Morse, quartic and periodic-cosine models
methods.name_zh: 解析自由粒子、谐振子、Morse、四次双阱与周期余弦模型
methods.scope: MorsePairPotential uses the Morse functional form. Free, harmonic, separable quartic and periodic-cosine providers are explicitly specified analytic controls; they are not fitted molecular or metal potentials.
methods.scope_zh: MorsePairPotential 使用 Morse 函数形式；自由粒子、谐振子、可分离四次双阱和周期余弦是明确给定的解析控制模型，不是拟合的分子或金属势。
methods.original_system: Morse: diatomic vibrational levels. The other generic test potentials do not specify one original molecular system or a unique originating paper.
methods.original_system_zh: Morse 原文研究双原子振动能级；其余通用测试势没有唯一指定的原始分子体系或方法论文。
methods.reproduce_observables: Energy/force finite differences, analytic harmonic equilibrium moments, Morse bound levels, exact quadrature FES and coordinate-periodicity checks. Match the energy zero and model parameters.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算能量/力有限差分、谐振子的解析平衡矩、Morse 束缚能级、积分自由能面和坐标周期性；统一能量零点与参数。
methods.gaps: A separable cosine model is not evidence for diffusion in a real material. Arbitrary Morse parameters do not reproduce a particular molecule from the 1929 paper.
methods.gaps_zh: 可分离余弦模型不能证明真实材料扩散正确；任意 Morse 参数也不等于复现 1929 原文的某个分子。

methods.name: Temperature/isotope scans, Arrhenius fits and convergence studies
methods.name_zh: 温度/同位素扫描、Arrhenius 拟合与数值收敛研究
methods.scope: Study orchestration and regression around already cited rate and isotope methods. No separate original paper is claimed for this package-specific scan/report workflow.
methods.scope_zh: 对已有速率与同位素方法进行研究组织和回归拟合；这个包内扫描/报告组合不硬配一篇独立原始论文。
methods.original_system: Use H + H2 and its isotopologues on the same identified PES for the rate campaign; use the original isotope-estimator water model for equilibrium fractionation.
methods.original_system_zh: 速率扫描采用同一已确认势能面上的 H + H₂ 及同位素体系；平衡分馏另用原估计器论文规定的水模型。
methods.reproduce_observables: k(T), k_H/k_D, fitted activation parameters with residuals, and paired refinement differences for beads, timestep, separation and maximum impact parameter. Predeclare equivalence margins.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 算 k(T)、k_H/k_D、活化参数与拟合残差，以及珠数、时间步、初始距离、最大碰撞参数改变后的差异；事先给定等效性容限。
methods.gaps: A good Arrhenius fit does not validate the rates or exclude tunnelling curvature; a statistically insignificant difference is not a convergence/equivalence result.
methods.gaps_zh: Arrhenius 拟合好不代表速率正确，也不排除隧穿曲率；差异不显著不能代替收敛或等效性证据。

methods.name: BKMP2 H3 literature benchmark and external PES provenance
methods.name_zh: BKMP2 H₃ 论文基准与外部势能面溯源
methods.scope: BKMP2 is an externally sourced H3 PES used by the benchmark, not a new potential fitted by PyRPMD. Cite its original paper in addition to the rate method and adapter/software source.
methods.scope_zh: 基准使用外部 BKMP2 H₃ 势，不是 PyRPMD 新拟合的势；除速率理论和软件接口外还要引用势能面原论文。
methods.original_system: BKMP2 1996: H + H2 rotational excitation and H3 PES validation. RPMD-rate papers use H + H2 exchange; these are different target calculations on the same PES family.
methods.original_system_zh: BKMP2 1996 原文研究 H + H₂ 转动激发和 H₃ 势能面验证；RPMD 速率论文研究 H + H₂ 交换，二者是同一势家族上的不同计算目标。
methods.reproduce_observables: First verify the surface, saddle, gradients and isotope masses; then reproduce PMF, k_QTST, kappa(t) and k(T). Reproduce the 1996 state-to-state cross sections only with its own initial states and scattering protocol.
methods.reproduce_observables_zh: 先核对势面、鞍点、梯度和同位素质量，再算 PMF、k_QTST、κ(t) 和 k(T)；1996 原文态到态截面必须另用它的初态与散射协议。
methods.gaps: Pin source bytes/checksum and channel/symmetry conventions. Existing fixed-P agreement leaves the separate parent-time, umbrella-precision and dynamic-bead convergence checks to complete.
methods.gaps_zh: 固定势文件及校验和、通道与对称性约定；已有固定珠数一致性仍留下父链时间、伞窗精度和动态珠数收敛需要完成。
